save.format.dwg.about: Ifomethi esetshenziswa yizinhlelo eziningi ze-CAD ukulondoloza. I-AutoCAD 2000 iyavula kuzo zonke izinguqulo ezilandelayo nakwezinye izinhlelo eziningi ze-CAD; inguqulo entsha igcina imibala yangempela. Igcina izingqimba, imibala, amabhulokhi nezici zawo, umbhalo, izilinganiso, imigqa yokufiphaza, amashidi namawindi awo okubuka, imibono eqanjiwe nezinyunithi.
dwg.save.truecolor: Imibala yangempela ilondoloziwe njengombala ojwayelekile oseduze (amafayela e-AutoCAD 2000 anemibala engu-255 ejwayelekile kuphela; londoloza njenge-AutoCAD 2004 noma kamuva ukuze uwagcine).

dwg.save.mleader.one: {n} multileader ilondoloziwe njengemigqa, ikhanda lomcibisholo nombhalo okudweba (ama-multileader e-DWG awakabhalwa okwamanje).
dwg.save.mleader.other: {n} ama-multileader alondolozwe njengemigqa, amakhanda omcibisholo nombhalo abawudwebayo (ama-multileader e-DWG awakabhalwa okwamanje).

dwg.save.mtextwidth: Umbhalo wemigqa eminingi ugcina izinhlamvu zawo ngobubanzi obujwayelekile (isilinganiso sobubanzi sisebenza kumbhalo womugqa owodwa kuphela ku-DWG).

dwg.save.paperview.one: {n} umbono oqanjiwe weshidi ulondoloziwe njengombono wesikhala sephepha: i-DWG ayirekhodi ukuthi yiliphi ishidi, ngakho i-CadCraft iyibeka eshidini lokuqala uma ifayela livulwa futhi.
dwg.save.paperview.other: {n} imibono eqanjiwe yamashidi ilondoloziwe njengemibono yesikhala sephepha: i-DWG ayirekhodi ukuthi yiliphi ishidi, ngakho i-CadCraft iyibeka emashidini okuqala uma ifayela livulwa futhi.

ml.title: Amaqoqo emephu
ml.screen_only: Izingqimba zemephu zidwetshwa esikrinini kuphela futhi azikhishwa. Uhlelo lokuxhumanisa nohlu lwezingqimba kulondolozwa nomdwebo (DWG noma DXF); izithombe zamafayela azinjalo. Iswishi yenethiwekhi igcinwa kulesi siphequluli.
ml.moved: Izingqimba zemephu nohlelo lokuxhumanisa manje sekulondolozwa nomdwebo. Lezo ezagcinwa yilesi siphequluli zikulo mdwebo: londoloza ukuze uzigcine.
ml.sys.kept: Lo mdwebo unendawo evela kwenye inhlelo, ohlelweni i-CadCraft engayaziyo ({name}). Igcinwa futhi ilondolozwe nomdwebo njengoba kwakunjalo. Khetha uhlelo ngezansi ukuze ulushintshe.
geo.read.code: Umdwebo unikeza uhlelo lokuxhumanisa i-CadCraft engayaziyo ({name}), ngakho izingqimba zemephu azikwazi ukubekwa. Indawo yawo igcinwa futhi ilondolozwe njengoba kwakunjalo.
geo.read.kind: Indawo yomdwebo ayisendaweni yegridi yemephu i-CadCraft engayisebenzisa ({name}), ngakho izingqimba zemephu azikwazi ukubekwa. Igcinwa futhi ilondolozwe njengoba kwakunjalo.
geo.read.scale: Indawo yomdwebo isebenzisa isikali sokulinganisa esingakwazi i-CadCraft ukusisebenzisa okwamanje ({name}), ngakho izingqimba zemephu azikwazi ukubekwa. Igcinwa futhi ilondolozwe njengoba kwakunjalo.
dwg.save.geo.old: Uhlelo lokuxhumanisa lulondolozelwa i-CadCraft kuphela ngenguqulo {v}: ezinye izinhlelo zifunda indawo yomdwebo kusukela ku-DWG 2010 noma ezintsha.
ml.net.label: Izingqimba zemephu ezivela ku-inthanethi
ml.net.body: Ivaliwe kuze kube yilapho uyivula. Lapho ivuliwe, i-CadCraft icela amaseva emephu ozengezayo izithombe zendawo ebonakala esikrinini. Umdwebo wakho uhlala kulesi sikhombisi; iseva ibona indawo nekheli lakho le-inthanethi.
ml.sys.none: Umdwebo awukabi nohlelo lwamakhoordinethi, ngakho izingqimba zemephu azikwazi ukubekwa. Khetha uhlelo okungene kulo amakhoordinethi awo ngezansi.
ml.sys.search.ph: Igama noma ikhodi ye-EPSG, isib. 2277 noma Texas Central
ml.sys.place.help: Uma umdwebo usesamakhoordinethi awo, shiya lezi zingu-0. Ngaphandle kwalokho nikeza iphoyinti elilodwa lomdwebo (X, Y), lapho likhona ekhasini lemephu (E, N), nokuthi i-X yomdwebo ijikwe kangakanani kusukela empumalanga (amadigri). Iyunithi yomdwebo (Izakhiwo › Iyunithi) iguqulelwa kuleyo yohlelo.
ml.why.off: Ivaliwe: izingqimba zemephu ezivela ku-inthanethi zivaliwe (inkinobho ephezulu).
ml.files.help: Khetha i-PNG noma i-JPEG kanye nefayela layo le-world (.pgw, .jgw noma .wld) futhi, uma likhona, ne-.prj yalo. Izithombe ezivela emafayeleni zihlala kuze kuvale leli khasi.
ml.help.xyz: Ikheli lethayela elinezinkamisa {{z}}, {{x}} kanye {{y}} (noma {{-y}}) lapho kuhamba khona izinga, ikholomu nomugqa; {{s}} ikhetha uhlamvu lweseva. Amathayela asekwe ku-web Mercator futhi aguqulwa abe uhlelweni lomdwebo.
ml.help.wms: Ikheli le-WMS (nesixhumanisi se-GetCapabilities nalo liyasebenza). I-CadCraft ifunda izingqimba zeseva, bese icela isithombe esisodwa sendawo ebonakala esikrinini.
ml.help.wmts: Ikheli le-WMTS, noma i-WMTSCapabilities.xml yalo. Isethi yematrix yamathayela ohlelweni lomdwebo iyasetshenziswa uma ikhona, kungenjalo i-web Mercator (eguqulwa).
ml.help.arcgis: Iseva yemephu noma yesithombe ye-ArcGIS: ikheli liphela nge-/MapServer noma nge-/ImageServer.
ml.net_first: Vula kuqala Izingqimba zemephu ezivela ku-inthanethi (phezulu).
ml.xyz.later: Ungayengeza manje; izobonakala uma izingqimba zemephu ezivela ku-inthanethi zivuliwe.

laser.aid: Thumela imidwebo kulaser: khetha ukuthi ungqimba ngalunye wenzani, bona ukuhamba kwekhanda, londoloza i-G-code yemodi yelaser ye-GRBL, noma uyithumele kusiphequluli. Hlola zonke izilungiselelo okuchithekayo kuqala, gqoka izibonakude zokuvikela ezilingana nelaser yakho, futhi ungalishiyi lilodwa ilaser elisebenzayo.
laser.start-values: Izinombolo ungqimba aqala ngazo ziwumbiko nje, hhayi izincomo zanoma yisiphi isinto: hlola kokuchithekayo bese ubhala lokho okusebenzayo. Izisika nezishayi zenziwa kuqala ngaphakathi, ngemva kokugcwalisa nezithombe.
laser.preview-label: Ukuhamba kwekhanda: imigqa eshisayo iboniswa ngombala, ukuhamba okusheshayo ngegreyi, ibhokisi eliluhlaza yilokho okushisayo
laser.nothing: Akukho okuthunyelwayo okwamanje: setha ungqimba oyedwa okungenani ukuze usike, ushaye, uqophe noma ugcwalise.
laser.est-note: Isikhathi siyisilinganiso ngaphandle kokusheshisa; umshini wangempela uthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu.
laser.warn-open-fill: Ungqimba {layer}: isimo esivulekile asikwazi ukugcwaliswa futhi asifakiwe.
laser.warn-shape-skipped: Ungqimba {layer} usethelwe isithombe: izimo zawo azifakiwe.
laser.warn-picture-skipped: Ungqimba {layer} awusethelwe ukuqopha isithombe: isithombe sawo asifakiwe.
laser.warn-out-of-bed: Umsebenzi ungu-{w} × {h} mm futhi awulingani nebhedi oyifakile.
laser.saved: I-G-code ilondoloziwe (imigqa {n}). Setha i-zero yomsebenzi ekhoneni elingezansi kwesobunxele lomsebenzi (noma ekuqaleni komdwebo, njengoba kukhethiwe) ngaphambi kokuyisebenzisa.
laser.send-note: Ukuthumela kusebenzisa i-Web Serial futhi kusebenza nezilawuli ze-GRBL ku-Chrome ne-Edge. Akukho okuxhumayo noma okuthunyelwayo kuze ucindezele inkinobho lapha, futhi Thumela ihlala ivaliwe kuze ikhanda selilandele ibhokisi lomsebenzi ngelaser livaliwe.
laser.no-serial: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukuxhumana nelaser nge-USB (akukho i-Web Serial). Londoloza i-G-code bese uyithumela ngohlelo lwelaser yakho.
laser.framed: Ikhanda lilandele ibhokisi lomsebenzi. Hlola ukuthi ihlezi phezu kwempahla yakho.
laser.confirm-frame: Ikhanda lizohamba lizungeze ibhokisi lomsebenzi ngelaser livaliwe. Ingabe indawo icacile ngaphandle kwanoma yini engashaywa?
laser.confirm-send: Ilaser izoqala. Ingabe impahla isendaweni futhi inohlaka, isivalo sivaliwe, izibonakude zokuvikela zigqokiwe, futhi kukhona umuntu oqapha umshini?
laser.stopped: Iyimile: ikhanda libanjiwe nelaser liphinde lisethwe futhi livaliwe.
laser.err-unsupported: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukusebenzisa i-Web Serial.
laser.machine-note: I-G-code ye-GRBL 1.1 kumodi yelaser: ukuhamba kwe-G0 ne-G1, M4 (noma M3) namanani e-S, M5 ekupheleni. Amafomethi ezinye izilawuli awakakhiwa.

appload.support.title: Ifolda yokusekela
appload.support.note: Ye-Studio kuphela. Khetha ifolda; {files} ekuyo ayalayishwa lapho i-CadCraft iqala (acaddoc.lsp futhi kuwo wonke amathebhu omdwebo amasha), futhi umsebenzi onegama elithi S::STARTUP abayichazile uyasebenza ngemva kwalokho. Kusiphequluli, sebenzisa i-Startup Suite engezansi.
appload.support.read: Akukwazanga ukufunda {name} (khetha futhi ifolda yokusekela ku-APPLOAD).

dwg.read.oles: {n} izinto ze-OLE ziboniswa njengesithombe sazo esilondoloziwe, noma njengorabha olunesilebhuli uma zingenaso. CadCraft ayiziqhubi noma ayihleli.

set.toolbar_dock.hint: Uhlangothi lwewindi ohlala kulo ibha yamathuluzi. Phezulu yindlela eyayihlala njalo. Isitayela semenyu yeribhoni senzelwe phezulu noma phansi; ibha yamathuluzi ye-CadCraft nesitayela sakudala nazo zifanele izinhlangothi. Ukusetha kabusha ukuhlelwa (Izilungiselelo › Okuvamile) kuyibuyisela phezulu. Ocingweni, ibha yamathuluzi ihlala lapho ukuhlelwa kwefoni kuyibeka khona.
cmd.toolbardock.help: Beka ibha yamathuluzi phezulu, phansi, ngakwesobunxele noma ngakwesokudla kwewindi
tour.title: Umdwebo wakho wokuqala
tour.started: Uhambo seluqalile: izinyathelo ezimfishane eziyisithupha, ebhokisini phezu komdwebo. Dlula noma yiliphi lazo, noma zonke.
tour.line.p: Thayipha {alias} ({cmd}) bese ucindezela Enter, uchofoze amaphoyinti amabili emdwebeni, bese ucindezela Enter ukuze uqedele. Noma chofoza Umugqa kubha yamathuluzi.
tour.circle.p: Thayipha {alias} ({cmd}) bese ucindezela Enter, uchofoze isikhungo, bese uchofoza noma uthayiphe ububanzi. Yenze idlule komugqa wakho.
tour.move.p: Chofoza indilinga ukuze uyikhethe, thayipha {alias} ({cmd}) bese ucindezela Enter, uchofoze iphoyinti lesisekelo, bese uchofoza lapho kufanele khona.
tour.trim.p: Thayipha {alias} ({cmd}) bese ucindezela Enter, bese uchofoza ingxenye yendilinga ephuma ngaphezu komugqa. Ukuchofoza ngakunye kususa ingxenye eyodwa. Cindezela Enter uma useqedile.
tour.erase.p: Chofoza into ukuze uyikhethe, bese uthayipha {alias} ({cmd}) bese ucindezela Enter. Ctrl+Z iyibuyisela.
tour.dim.p: Thayipha {alias} ({cmd}) bese ucindezela Enter, uchofoze amaphoyinti amabili, bese uchofoza lapho umugqa wesilinganiso kufanele khona.
tour.done.h: Udwebile, uhambisile, usikile, ususile futhi ulinganisile.
tour.done.p: Lokho kuyingxenye enkulu yokudweba. Ctrl+S igcina, Ctrl+P ishicilela ibe yi-PDF, futhi ishidi lezinqamuleli kuSizo liveza imiyalo engu-40 oyisebenzisa kakhulu. Thayipha TOUR ukuze ubone lokhu futhi.
cmd.tour.help: Yenza futhi uhambo lokudweba okokuqala oluneziyinyathelo eziyisithupha
set.tour.hint: Izinyathelo ezimfishane eziyisithupha ezidweba, zihambise, zisike, zisuse futhi zilinganise into. Iqala yodwa kuphela ngokuqala kokuqala.
set.tour.auto: Liqalise lodwa ngokuqala kokuqala lapho i-CadCraft ivula
set.tour.auto.hint: Izilungiselelo › Okujwayelekile › Uhambo lokuqala kuvala lokhu kuzo zonke izinhlelo.
cheat.cmd.scale: Yenza izinto zibe nkulu noma zibe ncane

cheat.cmd.explode: Hlukanisa ibhulokhi noma i-polyline ibe yizingxenye zayo

cheat.cmd.zoom: Sondeza ngaphakathi, ngaphandle noma kukho konke (E)
cheat.title: CadCraft: imiyalo engu-40 oyisebenzisa kakhulu
cheat.how: Thayipha igama elifushane (i-alias) bese ucindezela Enter, noma chofoza ithuluzi. Esc iyakhansela. Enter kumugqa ongenalutho iphinda umyalo wokugcina.
cheat.keys: Ctrl (Cmd ku-Mac): Z hlehlisa · Y phinda wenze · S londoloza · P shicilela.  F3 snap yento · F8 ortho · F10 polar.  Space noma Enter iphinda umyalo wokugcina · inkomba iyasondeza · ukudonsa inkomba kuyashelelisa
cheat.more: Okuningi: thayipha HELP ukuze uthole yonke imiyalo, TOUR ukuze uthole uhambo oluqondisiwe lokudweba okokuqala. getcadcraft.com/use/cadcraft

reg.pairs.few: Nika okungenani amapheya amathathu, ngalinye linenhloso.
reg.pairs.collinear: Lawo amaphoyinti ahlezi emugqeni munye, okungayilungisi ukuphendula. Khetha amaphoyinti angekho emugqeni.
reg.icp.nooverlap: Izikena azihlanganisi ngokwanele ukuze zihambisane. Beka iskena eduze kuqala (amapheya amaphoyinti).
reg.icp.degenerate: Amaphoyinti ahlanganisiwe ayinqumi indawo (ingxenye eyisicaba noma eqondile kuphela). Sebenzisa okwengeziwe kwesigcawu noma amapheya amaphoyinti.
reg.icp.noref: Khetha izikena ezimbili ezihlukile: eyodwa ehanjisiwe nensha okubekwa kuyo.
reg.units: Lezi zikena zisebenzisa izinyunithi ezihlukene: {a} kanye {b}. Ukuhlanganisa kwenziwa ngezinyunithi zamafayela uqobo; guqula eyodwa kuqala.
reg.empty: Engeza izikena ezimbili noma ezingaphezulu ukuqala.
reg.pairs.nopoint: Akukho phoyinti leskena eliseduze nokuchofoza. Sondeza bese uchofoza eduze kwephoyinti.
reg.icp.stopped: Kumiswe emva kwezinyathelo ezi-{n}. Iskena sihlala lapho sifinyelele khona; Hlehlisa kuyisibuyisela.
reg.export.done: Kubhalwe {file}: amaphoyinti {n}, wonke amaskena endaweni yawo ehlanganisiwe.
reg.export.toomany: Amaphoyinti amaningi kakhulu ku-LAS eyodwa. Vala ukufunda wonke amaphoyinti, noma uthumele izikena ezimbalwa.
reg.project.saved: Iphrojekthi ilondoloziwe: izikena {n}, ukuguqulwa kwazo namakhomba amafayela awo (akukho amaphoyinti).
reg.project.big: Leli fayela likhulu kakhulu ukuba yiphrojekthi yokuhlanganisa.
reg.project.partial: Kubekwe izikena {matched} kwezikena {total}. Azivulekile: {names}. Engeza lawo mafayela, bese uvula iphrojekthi futhi.
reg.view.label: Izikena efulemini elihlanganisiwe; chofoza iphoyinti ukuzeliyikhethe
reg.title: Hlanganisa izikena
reg.intro: Beka izikena ezimbalwa efulemini elilodwa: khetha amaphoyinti afanayo noma uthayiphe izinhloso, bese uthuthukisa nge-ICP. Iskena ngalinye ligcina amaphoyinti alo; ngalinye lithola utshintsho olulodwa.
reg.add.title: Engeza amafayela ezikena (LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY, PCD, PTX, PTS, XYZ), noma iphrojekthi yokuhlanganisa
reg.pairs.title: Beka ngamapheya amaphoyinti noma izinhloso
reg.pairs.hint: Chofoza iphoyinti eskenini ukuze uhambise, bese uchofoza indawo efanayo kwenye iskena. Noma khetha iphoyinti uthayiphe izixhumanisi zenhloso. Amapheya amathathu noma ngaphezulu, angekho emugqeni munye.
reg.icp.title: Thuthukisa nge-ICP
reg.icp.hint: Ihambisa iskena kuze kumile phezu kwezindawo zeskena elinye. Idinga ukubekwa okuyinhlamvu kuqala.
reg.out.title: Londoloza bese uthumela
reg.export.all: Funda wonke amaphoyinti kumafayela (kuze kufike ezigidini {max} ngeskena ngalinye)
reg.view.hint: Hudula ukuze ushelelise, skrola ukuze usondeze, chofoza ukuze ukhethe
reg.help.cmd: Hlanganisa izikena ezimbalwa: zibeke efulemini elilodwa ngamapheya amaphoyinti noma izinhloso, thuthukisa nge-ICP, uthumele i-LAS noma i-E57 eyodwa
reg.icp.mode.both: Iphoyinti kuya kwelinye, bese kuya kwendiza
reg.pairs.pick_target: Manje chofoza indawo efanayo kwenye iskena.
reg.pairs.typed_hint: Iphoyinti lengeziwe. Thayipha izixhumanisi zenhloso yalo emugqeni.

scan.help.align: Hambelanisa ishidi eskeniwe namaphoyinti amabili: hambisa, jikisa futhi, uma ukhetha, linganisa.
scan.help.deskew: Thola i-engeli imigqa emide yeshidi eskeniwe emile kuyo, bese uyijikisa ibe ngqo uma usuvumile i-engeli.
scan.help.clean: Yenza ishidi eskeniwe libe mnyama nomhlophe bese ususa izinhlamvana.
scan.help.erase: Susa indawo yeshidi eskeniwe: irektangela, ipolygon noma i-lasso.
scan.help.trace: Guqula ishidi eskeniwe libe imigqa nemisalo ngungqimba omusha, ngokubekezelela okusethiwe. Umbhalo nemigqa yokufiphaza kuhlala njengamapikseli.
scan.help.info: Bonisa ifayela loqobo leshidi eskeniwe nezinyathelo ezithathiwe kusukela ngaleso sikhathi.
scan.help.snap: Vula noma uvale ukubamba emigqeni yamashidi eskeniwe.

sx.vault.cmd.help: Vula ipaneli Yamadokhumenti: hlola amadwebo aphuma nangenayo, izinguqulo, izimo zokukhishwa nokuvunywa kwefolda yephrojekthi
sx.vault.intro: Gcina amadwebo efolda yephrojekthi elawulwayo: phuma ngefayela ukuze kungabi nomuntu oliguqulayo, ngenisele njengenguqulo entsha, uyithumele ukuze ibukwe futhi uyikhiphe ngegama lomvumi. Konke kugcinwa efoldeni ngokwalo (ifolda efihliwe i-.ccvault), ngakho ifolda eyabelwanayo noma ehlanganiswa iyasebenza ithimba lonke. Asidingeki iseva.
sx.vault.nofolders: Amafolda ephrojekthi adinga i-CadCraft Studio, noma isiphequluli esisekelwe ku-Chromium (i-Chrome, i-Edge) esingavula ifolda.
sx.vault.folder.exclusive: Ukuphuma kulapha kukhiyelwe yisistimu yamafayela: abantu ababili abakwazi ukuphuma ngefayela elifanayo.
sx.vault.folder.besteffort: Ukuphuma kulapha kukhiyelwe njengoba leli folda livumela: abantu ababili abaphuma ngefayela elifanayo ngesikhashana esincane bangalithola bobabili. I-Studio enesheli entsha iyobakhiya ngokuqinile.
sx.vault.you.none: Thayipha igama lakho kuqala: liyoyiswa kuwo wonke ukuphuma, ukungenisa nokuvuma.
sx.vault.novault: Le folda ayikabi yisitoreji sephrojekthi okwamanje.

plotstyle.err.ctb.not_ctb: Leli fayela alibambi itafula lesitayela sokushicilela i-CadCraft engalifunda. I-CTB eyenziwe yenye inhlelo kufanele ifundeke; uma kunjalo, sicela uyasithumela kithi.
plotstyle.err.ctb.named: Lena itafula lesitayela sokushicilela esinegama (STB). I-CadCraft ifunda amatafula ancika embaleni (CTB).
plotstyle.err.ctb.big: Leyo fayela likhulu kakhulu ukuba yithebula lesitayela sokuphrinta.
plotstyle.ctb.caution: Leli tafula lifundwe ngencazelo eshicilelwe yale fomethi futhi alikahlolwa nge-CTB evela kwenye inhlelo. Qhathanisa ukushicilela kokuqala nalokho okulindele: umbala, ukufiphaza kanye nobubanzi bomugqa ngombala kuyafundwa; ukumnyama kwemvelo, izinombolo zamapeni, izinhlobo zemigqa, iziphetho zemigqa nezitayela zokugcwalisa akufundwa.
diagram.help: Dweba uhlaka ngombhalo: i-Mermaid flowchart, icebo le-PlantUML, D2, uhlu lokusuka-kuya noma i-draw.io XML, njengamabhulokhi nezixhumanisi ongazihlela
diagram.dlg.label: Namathisela umbhalo womdwebo
diagram.dlg.note: I-Mermaid (flowchart noma graph), i-PlantUML (@startuml component noma deployment), D2, uhlu oluneNkambu ze-from, to kanye ne-label, noma i-draw.io XML (ifayela elilondoloziwe le-.drawio noma okubhalwa imodeli; izindawo zalo ziyagcinwa). Ifundwa njengombhalo ovamile futhi idwetshwe njengezinto ezijwayelekile.

diagram.err.compressed: Leli fayela le-draw.io likhanyisiwe ngendlela lesi siphequluli esingayivula. Ku-draw.io sebenzisa Ifayela > Thumela njenge > XML ngokungakhethiwe kwe-Compressed, bese uyinamathisela lapha.

set.filekeys.hint: Yonke into oyidwebayo ithola ukhiye omfushane ongashintshi, olondolozwa ku-DWG noma DXF. Ngalokho i-Git, i-Fossil noma i-Mercurial zingahlanganisa ukuhlelwa kwabantu ababili komdwebo owodwa into ngento (cadcraft merge, docs/FILE-FORMATS.md). Kubiza cishe amaphesenti ayi-10 ngobukhulu befayela; yivale uma ungakaze uhlanganise.
set.autocomplete.hint: Lapho kungekho lutho olusebenza, isithunzi esingwaqa sibonisa okusho amaphethini omdwebo wakho ukuthi kuzolandela (isigxobo esilandelayo, isinyathelo esilandelayo sesitebe, udonga olusalayo). Phakathi kwe-LINE noma i-PLINE sibonisa iphoyinti elilandelayo (isinyathelo esilandelayo sesitebe, ikona yesine yerektangili, iphoyinti lokuvala). Thepha i-Tab ukuyithatha, u-Esc uyichitha. Kwenziwa kule khompyutha kusukela ezintweni ezisha, ngemithetho, ngaphandle kwemodeli.

autosheet.split: Konke bekungeke kulingane eshidini elilodwa, ngakho ingxenye ngayinye yathola eyayo.
autosheet.help: Ihlela amashidi yodwa: ikhetha iphepha nezikali ezijwayelekile futhi ibeka yonke imibono nencazelo nebhulokhi lesihloko.
details.prompt.block: Igama lebhulokhi kulo mdwebo lokuyengeza emininingwaneni yenkampani
details.empty: Ilabhulaliwe yemininingwane yenkampani ayinalutho. DETAILS › Engeza ibeka ibhulokhi yalo mdwebo kuyo.
details.none: Akukho okwemininingwane elabhulaliwe okufana nalokho okukhethiwe noma okwadwetshwa ekugcineni.
details.noblock: Akukho bhulokhi ebizwa ngokuthi {name} kulo mdwebo.
details.full: Ilabhulaliwe yemininingwane igcwele noma leli bhrawuza alikwazi ukuyigcina.
details.share.nofolder: Vula kuqala ifolda ye-Documents (ipaneli ye-Documents ivulwa manje); imininingwane yenkampani eyabelwana ihlala kuleyo folda, ngakho ifolda ye-Team Cloud Plan iyabelana nayo ngethimba.
details.share.done: Imininingwane eyabelwanwe: {pulled} yengezwe lapha, {pushed} yengezwe ngethimba, {filled} inikezwe umdwebo wayo.
details.share.error: Imininingwane eyabelwanwe ayikwazanga ukufundwa noma ukubhalwa: {why}
details.help: Imininingwane yenkampani yakho, etholakala ngalokho odweba khona: thola, engeza ibhulokhi, lalela, susa, vula noma vala izeluleko.
lib.panel.firm.notdetail: {name} akuyona into yemininingwane, ngakho ayikwazi ukujoyina imininingwane yenkampani.
set.details.hint: Lapho okukhethiwe kufana nemininingwane elabhulaliwe yenkampani yakho (DETAILS), umugqa ubhalwe ngaphansi uyakusho lokho. Kufanisa ngamagama kulo kompyutha, ngaphandle kwemodeli.
gridmove.notline: Lokho akusiwo umugqa. Umugqa wegridi umugqa osesendlalelweni segridi.
gridmove.distance: Ibanga lokufuduswa (+ kuwo ngakwesobunxele kwecala lomugqa)
gridmove.done: Umugqa wegridi ufudulwe nento ehlanganyelwe nawo: {moved} kufudulwe ngokuphelele, {stretched} kwelulwe, {dims} izilinganiso, {notes} amathegi. Ctrl+Z iyawuhlehlisa konke.
gridmove.help: Fudusa umugqa wegridi uphinde uthwale lokho okuxhunyiwe kuwo: izindonga ziyelulwa, izinsika, izimpawu namathegi ziyafuduka, izilinganiso ziyalandela.
autodim.prompt: Ukulinganisa okuzenzakalelayo {what}: ubukhulu jikelele {overall}, amaketanga {chain}, izivulo {openings}, izimbobo {holes}, igridi {grid}, izinhlangothi {sides} [Ubukhulu jikelele (O)/Amaketanga (C)/Izivulo (O)/Izimbobo (H)/Igridi (G)/Izinhlangothi (S)/Qalisa (R)]
autodim.prompt.sides: Izinhlangothi zomdwebo okulinganiswa (ezansi, ngakwesobunxele, phezulu, ngakwesokudla; ukuhlukanisa ngekhoma)
autodim.done: Izilinganiso {total} zenziwe: {chain} emaketangeni, {overall} ubukhulu jikelele, {openings} izivulo, {holes} izimbobo, {grid} igridi ({skipped} sezikhona kakade). Ctrl+Z iyazihlehlisa zonke.
autodim.help: Linganisa ngemithetho: ubukhulu jikelele, amaketanga ngakunhlangothi, izivulo, ububanzi bezimbobo nokuhlukana kwegridi, kungaphindwa okuseyelinganisiwe.
psk.prompt: Isithombe sokudweba ngesandla: iphepha {paper}, isikali 1:{scale}, isendlalelo ngasinye semibala yepeni {colours} [Iphepha (P)/Isikali (S)/Imibala (C)/Qalisa (R)]
psk.prompt.scale: Isikali sokudweba: 1 : n (1 = iphepha ngokwalo; 50 = yonke i-mm ephepheni ilingana ne-50 mm)
psk.noink: Ishidi litholakele, kepha akukho imigqa yepeni kulo.
psk.done: Isithombe sokudweba sidwetshwe: izinto {n} ezisendlalelweni {layers} ngesikali 1:{scale}. Ctrl+Z iyawuhlehlisa.
psk.done.whole: Umphetho wephepha awutholakalanga, ngakho isithombe sonke sathathwa njengeshidi: izinto {n} ezisendlalelweni {layers} ngesikali 1:{scale}. Ctrl+Z iyawuhlehlisa.
psk.note: Kuqondisiwe futhi kulandelwe ngemithetho kulo kompyutha. Imibhalo ishiywe; hlola imigqa ngokuhambisana nesikhethi sakho.
psk.help: Iguqula isithombe somdwebo wesandla ephepheni sibe imigqa namanxantathu ngesikali, siqondise ukubonakala kwesithombe, bese sinikeza ipeni ngalinye umbala wesendlalelo sawo.
access.arc: {lead}, iradiyasi {r}, ubude {len}, isentha: {at}, kusukela {a0} kuya {a1} degrees.
access.sel.many: Izinto {n} zikhethiwe. Cindezela S ukuze uthole ezokuqala.
access.canvas.focus: Umdwebo. Izinkinobho zomcibisholo zihambisa ikhesa, Enter ikhetha iphuyinti, Tab ihamba iphuyinti elilandelayo lokuhlangana, uphawu lombuzo ludwebe izinkinobho.
access.canvas.aria: Umdwebo, ikhesa lokhibhodi. Izinkinobho zomcibisholo zihambisa, Enter ikhetha iphuyinti, Tab ihamba phakathi kwamaphuyinti okuhlangana, D ichaza umdwebo, uphawu lombuzo ludwebe izinkinobho.
access.keys.help: Izinkinobho zomcibisholo zihambisa ikhesa; Shift ihambisa kayishumi kakhulu, Control kancane ngengxenye eyishumi. Enter ikhetha iphuyinti. Space iphelisa umyalo, njengoba u-Enter enza emugqeni womyalo. Tab noShift Tab zihamba phakathi kwamaphuyinti okuhlangana. G idlulisa phakathi kwezibambo zokukhethiwe. D ichaza umdwebo, W isho lapho useku, N okuseduze, S okukhethiwe, R iphinda. V ivula noma ivala izwi. Slash ihamba emugqeni womyalo.
access.voice.listening_online: Ilalela. Isiphequluli sakho sithumela umsindo kwisevisi yaso yenkulumo ku-inthanethi.
access.voice.needs_online_ok: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukubona inkulumo kulo kompyutha, futhi ukubona ku-inthanethi akuvunyelwe. Bheka Izilungiselelo, Ukufinyelela.
access.voice.error: Umakrofoni noma ukubona inkulumo kuyeke ngephutha.
access.help.access: Vula noma vala ukudweba ngaphandle kokubona: imiphumela ichazwa ngomfundi wesikrini sakho, ikhesa lokhibhodi emdwebeni, imisindo yamaphuyinti okuhlangana nemiyalo ekhulunywayo.
access.help.describe: Chaza ukuthi umdwebo unani: izinto ezingaki, zinhlobo ini, zinkulu kangakanani, yini ekhethiwe.
access.help.nearby: Chaza okuseduze kwekhesa, okuseduze kakhulu kuqala, nekhashana nohlangothi.
access.help.voice: Vula noma vala imiyalo ekhulunywayo. Ibonwa kulo kompyutha.
set.access.hint: Ivula imiphumela ekhulunywayo ngomfundi wesikrini, indawo yokudweba ongayifinyelela ngeTab uyihambise ngezinkinobho zomcibisholo, nezincazelo zomdwebo.
set.access.voice.hint: Kulo kompyutha kusho ukuthi isiphequluli sibona inkulumo ngokwaso futhi umsindo awuphumi kuso. Lapho isiphequluli singenakho, inketho ye-ku-inthanethi ivumela isiphequluli ukuthumela umsindo kwisevisi yenkulumo yomenzi waso; i-CadCraft ayithumeli lutho lwayo.
redline.help: Redline ibe ukubuyekezwa: funda iphakheji ye-redline ye-MarkupCraft, vuma noma ala ushintsho ngalunye, ufake amafu ezivunyiwe ngelogi yokubuyekezwa, bese ulondoloza ifayela lezimpendulo (RDL)
redline.bad.not_json: Leli fayela alisiwo JSON, ngakho alisiwo iphakheji ye-redline.
redline.bad.not_redline: Leli fayela alisiwo iphakheji ye-redline (i-*.redline.json ye-MarkupCraft).
redline.bad.version: Leli phakheji ye-redline liyinguqulo entsha kunaleyo i-CadCraft ayifunda ngayo.
redline.bad.too_many: Leli phakheji ye-redline linezinto eziningi kunalezo i-CadCraft ayifunda ngesikhathi esisodwa.
redline.bad.bad_id: Leli phakheji ye-redline linento enenombolo yokukhomba engasebenzi.
redline.bad.no_geometry: Leli phakheji ye-redline linento engenayo indawo ephepheni.

redline.which: Yiziphi izinguquko? Izinombolo zohlu (1,3-5) noma Konke
redline.note: Inothi lefayela lezimpendulo (Enter ukuze ungabi nalutho)
redline.frame.first: Ikhona lokuqala lendawo yomdwebo ebonwa ishidi (Enter = umdwebo wonke)
redline.frame.empty: Umdwebo awunalutho, ngakho akukho lapho okungabekwa khona izinguquko. Khetha indawo yomdwebo nge-Frame.
redline.saved: Ifayela {name} lilondoloziwe ngezimpendulo {n}. Livule ku-MarkupCraft ukuze uvale izimaka.

lesson.first.title: Umdwebo wakho wokuqala
lesson.first.intro: Dweba igumbi elincane, libeke ungqimba lalo, lilinganise bese ulilondoloza. Isinyathelo ngasinye siqeda ngokwaso lapho umdwebo usikhombisa.
lesson.first.lines.h1: Bhala RECTANGLE (REC) komugqa womyalo, chofoza iphoyinti elilodwa, bese uchofoza ikhona elikude nalo.
lesson.first.lines.h2: Noma sebenzisa LINE (L) uchofoze amakhona amane, uvale ngelokuqala.
lesson.first.layer.h1: Vula iphaneli Yezingqimba, wengeze ungqimba bese unikeza igama elifana ne-WALLS.
lesson.first.dim.h1: Bhala DIMLINEAR (DLI), chofoza zombili izincele zodonga, bese uchofoza lapho isilinganiso kufanele sibe khona.
lesson.first.save.h1: Cindezela Ctrl+S, noma sebenzisa Ifayela › Londoloza.
bundle.cad.nodwg: "{file}" sikhwama sephrojekthi, kodwa asinayo imidwebo ye-DWG. I-CadCraft ivula imidwebo esikhwameni; I-BimCraft ivula iphrojekthi yonke (imodeli, amashidi nemigomo).
bundle.cad.standards: Imigomo esuka esikhwameni: izingqimba: {layers} nezinhlobo zemigqa yamadashi: {types} zengeziwe. Izingqimba nezinhlobo zemigqa umdwebo wawunazo zishiyiwe njengoba zinjalo.
bundle.cad.std.combination: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezingqimba "{name}" akukho esikhwameni; izingqimba zengeziwe njengoba zidwelwe.
bundle.cad.std.symbol: Uhlobo lomugqa "{name}" lunezimpawu, ezingadwetshwa yi-CadCraft; alengezwanga.
bundle.cad.std.nopattern: Uhlobo lomugqa "{name}" alunayo iphethini yamadashi esebenzayo; alengezwanga.
bundle.cad.std.penloaded: {n} amasethi epeni engezwe njengamatafula esitayela sokushicilela aqanjwe ngokuthi "Archicad - …": ipeni 3 likhipha izinto zombala 3 ngombala nobukhulu balowo peni (Shicilela › Izitayela zokushicilela).
bundle.cad.std.penset: Isethi yepeni "{name}" alinaye ipeni elinombala noma ubukhulu; alengezwanga.
bundle.cad.std.pentaken: Ithebula lesitayela sokushicilela "{name}" sesivele kumdwebo (noma umdwebo unamatafula amaningi kunavumelekile); lishiyiwe njengoba linjalo.

frame.err.no-supports: Akukho okubamba uhlaka: alinasekelo. Lunike izisekelo zensika (Izisekelo kwi-Model assumptions) noma isekelo lalo.
frame.err.mechanism: Uhlaka lungahamba ngaphandle kokugoba lutho (umshini) endaweni {at}, {dof}. Lubambe lapho ngesekelo, ngesixhumi esiqinile noma ngesiqinisi, bese uqalisa futhi.
frame.err.release-unstable: Ilunga {member} likhululwe ngendlela efanayo emaphethelweni womabili, ngakho lingazungeza noma lishelele lodwa. Gcina iphethelo elilodwa liqinile.
frame.err.not-json: Lona akuyona ifayela lemodeli yohlaka (alikho JSON).
frame.err.newer: Le modeli yohlaka yalondolozwa ngenguqulo entsha kakhulu (ifomethi {version}). Buyekeza uhlelo ukuze uyivule.
frame.warn.idle-dof: Akukho okuqinisa uhlaka endaweni {node} {dof}, futhi akukho okuyiphusha ngaleyo ndlela: ibanjiwe lapho.
frame.warn.idle-rotation: Zonke izilungu endaweni {node} zibotshiwe, ngakho akukho okuphendula lowo xhumanisi {dof}: ubanjiwe lapho. Ukuthi kulowo xhumanisi kube nomthwalo wokugoba kungaba yimishini.
frame.warn.loose-node: Indawo endaweni {node} ayiyona ingxenye yalutho futhi ishiywe ngaphandle.
frame.warn.bad-node: Indawo lapho ukuma kwayo kungekho noma kungafundeki yashiywa ngaphandle.
frame.warn.bad-material: Impahla enamanani angekho noma angafundeki yashiywa ngaphandle.
frame.warn.bad-section: Isigaba esinamanani angekho noma angafundeki yashiywa ngaphandle.
frame.warn.bad-member: Ilunga {id} lashiywa ngaphandle: indawo, isigaba noma impahla okuyibiza ayikho.

frame.warn.bad-support: Isekelo lashiywa ngaphandle: indawo yalo ayikho noma linikezwe kabili.

frame.note.ifc-material: Izinto zemodeli azifundwa: wonke ilunga liyinsimbi ngaphandle uma igama layo lezinto liqamba ukhonkolo noma izinkuni.
frame.ui.title: Ukuhlaziya kohlaka
frame.ui.needs-ifc: Vula imodeli ye-IFC ukuze uhlaziye amabhimu, izinsika nezinqinisi zayo.
frame.ui.aid: Isisiza sokuhlaziya, hhayi ukuhlola kwekhodi: amandla, okusekela nokwehla kwezilungu njengoba zimodelwe, ngokuhlaziya kokuqala okulinganayo. Akuhloli khodi yokwakha. Unjiniyela uhlola imodeli futhi unquma ukuthi izinombolo zisho ukuthini. Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa okungezansi (insimbi, ukhonkolo) nemithwalo yokuzamazama komhlaba kuyizinyathelo ezihlukile, ezingakhethwa.
frame.ui.results-none: Akukaqalisi. Engeza imithwalo, bese ucindezela Qalisa ukuhlaziya.
frame.ui.results-stale: Imodeli ishintshe kusukela ekuhlaziyweni kokugcina: qalisa ukuhlaziya futhi.
frame.ui.summary: Amaphoyinti {nodes}, amalunga {members}, okungaziwa {dofs}, {ms} ms. Imithwalo phansi {fz} kN, okusekela phezulu {rz} kN.
frame.ui.signs: Inani elikhulu kunazo zonke ngaphakathi kwelungu ngalinye, nophawu lwalo. N > 0 kuwukucindezela kokuqina; My > 0 noMz > 0 zenza uhlangothi lwelungu olungaphansi -z kanye -y lube sekuqineni (ibhimu elipholisa ngaphansi kwesisindo linguMy > 0); ukuthambeka kulinganiswa kusuka emgqeni ohlanganisa imiphetho yelungu.
frame.ui.load-pick: Khetha amalungu amaningi noma elilodwa ukuze uwalayishe.
frame.ui.load-bad-range: Kusuka no-Kuya kufanele kube izinkapha ezingaphakathi kulungu, Kusuka ingaphambi kuKuya.
frame.ui.combos-none: Akukho zinhlanganisela: icala ngalinye libonakala lodwa.
frame.ui.combos-note: Inhlanganisela ifaka amacala ndawonye ngezilinganiso zawo (imiphumela iyengezeka: ukuhlaziywa kuyalingana). Bhala izilinganiso ekucelwa yikhodi yakho yokwakha; uhlelo alukhethi zona.
frame.ui.assume-note: Amalungu ahlaziywa ngemigqa yawo yokusebenza. Okokugcina kwebhimu nethebhu yokusika kubotshiwe, nephleyithi yokugcina iqinile. Khetha ilungu elilodwa ukuze unikeze okokugcina kwalo, noma isisekelo sensika, umthetho walo.

frame.ui.pdf-missing.one: Umbiko wokuhlaziya uyalandwa. Uhlamvu oyedwa umfanekiso we-PDF ungawunaki lubonakala njenge-"?".
frame.ui.pdf-missing.other: Umbiko wokuhlaziya uyalandwa. Izinhlamvu ezingu-{n} umfanekiso we-PDF ungazinaki zibonakala njenge-"?".

frame.ui.craft-title: Ukuhlaziya kohlaka lwe-{name}, njengefayela le-CraftScript: lisebenze ku-workspace ye-Script ye-PartCraft (frame3d kulabhulari).
frame.ui.craft-note: Izinyuvesi: mm, N, MPa. Yonke icala lisebenza nge-frame3d; izinhlanganisela ziyengeza imiphumela.
frame.ui.craft-done: Uhlaka luyalandwa njengefayela le-CraftScript (vula kwi-workspace ye-Script ye-PartCraft).
frame.rep.not-a-check: Isisiza sokuhlaziya, hhayi ukuhlola kwekhodi. Ikhodi yokwakha ayisetshenziswanga; unjiniyela uhlola imodeli, imithwalo nokusekela kwayo, aphinde anqume ukuthi amanani asho ukuthini.
frame.rep.method-text: Indlela yobuqinile eqondile, eyisigaba nokuqala (akukho P-delta): amakholomu ebhimu e-Euler–Bernoulli anobuqinile bokuphenduka, ukugoba ababili; ukukhululwa kokugcina ngokuncishiswa kwesimo; imithwalo esemalungwini ngemisebenzi yesimo sawo.
frame.rep.units-text: kN, kN·m, mm; ukuzungezisa ngama-milliradian. I-Z ejwayelekile iphezulu; ukudonsela kusebenza ngokuya ku-−Z.
frame.rep.signs-text: Inani elikhulu kunawo wonke ngelungu ngalinye, nesimpawu salo. N > 0 ukuqinisa; My > 0 no-Mz > 0 kwenza uhlangothi lwe-−z nolwe-−y kuqiniswe; ukuguquka kulinganiswa kusukela emugqeni phakathi kwezigcina zelungu.
frame.rep.size-text: {nodes} amaphoyinti, {members} amalungu, {supports} izisekelo, {cases} amacala omthwalo, {combos} izinhlanganisela, {dofs} okungaziwa.
frame.rep.envelope: Isimo esiphezulu: inani elikhulu kunawo wonke amacala nezinhlanganisela
frame.des.aid: Izinhlolo zezingxenye zensimbi ngokwekhodi yedizayini, zezigaba ze-I. Iyisisekelo kuze kubuyekezwe unjiniyela: amandla okuqala kuphela (akukho imiphumela yesibili), akukho ukujikeleka, akukho zingxenye ezincane noma zesigaba 4, akukho oxhumano. Ayithathi indawo yokuhlola kwenjiniyela.
frame.des.pick: Khetha ikhodi yedizayini ukuze wenze izinhlanganisela zemithwalo uhlole izingxenye zensimbi.
frame.des.lengths-note: Ukubopha kuthathwa ngokuhlukaniswa okulinganayo kuwo wonke umugqa, kusukela ekuqaleni kwawo; kulawula ubude bokukhuhlana kwe-axis ebuthakathaka nobude bokuphambuka okuhlangene nokujikeleka. I-K iphindaphinda ubude bengxenye (i-axis eqinile) nobude obuboshiwe (i-axis ebuthakathaka). Lawa manani asebenza kuzo zonke izingxenye.
frame.des.na-note: Amanani ancomekayo e-EN 1990 ne-EN 1993-1-1. Shintsha lawa ukuze afanane ne-National Annex yezwe lakho; alondolozwa nephrojekthi.
frame.des.made: Izinhlanganisela ezingu-{n} zidaliwe ({clause}). Izinhlanganisela ezibhalwe ngesandla zigcinwe.
frame.des.checked: Izingxenye ezingu-{n} zihloliwe, ezingu-{bad} ziphezu komthwalo wazo, ezingu-{skip} azihlolwanga.
frame.des.no-combos: Azikho izinhlanganisela zedizayini okwamanje: cindezela Dala izinhlanganisela.
frame.des.have-combos: Izinhlanganisela ezingu-{n} zamandla nezingu-{m} zokusebenza zisetshenziswa.
frame.des.none-yet: Cindezela Hlola izingxenye ukuze ubone ukusetshenziswa kwengxenye ngayinye.
frame.des.stale: Imodeli ishintshe kusukela ekuhlolweni kokugcina. Cindezela Hlola izingxenye futhi.
frame.des.err.no-made: Akukho okuzohlanganiswa: nikeza amacala uhlobo (lufu, ophilayo, umoya …).
frame.des.err.no-combos: Dala izinhlanganisela kuqala: kuphela ezidalelwe ikhodi ezihlolwayo.
frame.des.err.no-solution: Ukuhlaziywa akuzange kusebenze; lungisa lokho kuqala.
frame.des.signs: Ukusetshenziswa kuwukudinga ngokwehlulela kumandla: u-100 % umkhawulo. Izingxenye zifakwa umbala emodelini: okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kusetshenziswa kancane, okuluhlaza cishe uhhafu, okunsundu eduze komkhawulo, okubomvu kudlula, okuthaphu akuhlolwanga.
frame.des.title: Izinhlolo zedizayini
frame.des.first-order-text: Okokuqala. Imiphumela yesibili (P-Δ, P-δ, ukukhulisa) ayifakiwe; yihlole ngaphambi kokuthembela emphumeleni.
frame.des.lengths-text: K i-axis eqinile {ky}, K i-axis ebuthakathaka {kz}, ubude obuboshiwe {lb} wengxenye, okubopha kulinganiswe kusukela ekuqaleni.
frame.des.not-built-text: Ukujikeleka, izingxenye ezincane nezesigaba 4, izigaba ezakhiwe ngewelda, izigaba ezingezona ezse-I, oxhumano, ukukhathala, umlilo, ukwakheka kokuzamazama.
frame.des.counts-text: {n} zihloliwe ({partial} kuzo ngokuphelele), {bad} ziphezu komthwalo, {skip} azihlolwanga; izinhlanganisela zamandla ezingu-{combos}.
frame.des.modulus-text: Ukuhlaziywa kusebenzise E = {model} MPa; izibalo zomthwalo zisebenzisa E = {design} MPa.
frame.slab.title: Ukuqiniswa kwe-islebhu (ACI 318-19)
frame.slab.aid: Insimbi i-islebhu eyenziwe ngamapuleti iyidingayo, kusuka ezikhathini zamapuleti kuyo yonke inhlanganisela yamandla: izikhathi zokugoba nokujikeleza ndawonye ngomthetho we-Wood–Armer, ungqimba phansi nangaphezulu ngayinye yezinqubo, bese kuba ukuhlinza kwendlela eyodwa. Isisiza umndeni wobunjiniyela ukuhlola.
frame.slab.done: Kuklanywe amapuleti {n} ezinhlanganisweni {combos}: ungqimba olusetshenziswa kakhulu: {util}.
frame.slab.err.no-combos: Yenza kuqala izinhlanganisela zamandla bese uqalisa ukuhlaziya.
frame.slab.limits: Akuhlanganisiwe: ukukhothama (ubukhulu buyinto yakho), ukungena kwamandla emakholomini, izinti ezihlaziyayo ezizungeze izimbobo, ukunciphisa kanye nokuxhuma. Izinqumo ezingaphezu kokuxhaswa ziya ngokuya kancane ngamapuleti amane: hlaziya imeshi lapho. Ungqimba x uyiwona ongaphandle.
frame.slab.prob.flexure: Islebhu, {layer}: idinga {need} mm²/m; izinti {bar} mm, isikhala {s} mm, zinikeza {prov} (ipuleti {plate}, {set}).
frame.slab.prob.shear: Ukuhlinza kwendlela eyodwa kwe-islebhu {Vu} kN/m, ngokuchasene ne-φVc {phiVc} kN/m (ipuleti {plate}, {set}).
frame.break.aid: Ithola okuzoqala ukuvela ohlakeni: inhlanganisela yamandla ebusayo, ilunga elibuthakathaka, isilinganiso somthwalo lapho ilunga lokuqala lifinyelela umkhawulo walo (inhlanganisela ebusayo ekalwe kabusha, ixazululwe futhi ngalo lonke ikhathi), kanye nesixhumanisi esibuthakathaka sezikulufo lapho imodeli ibhala ukuthi izikulufo zithwala ni. Isebenzisa izilungiselelo zokuklama ezingenhla.
frame.break.none-yet: Cindezela inkinobho ukuze uthole. Yenza kuqala izinhlanganisela bese usetha ikhodi yokuklama ngenhla.
frame.break.reserve: Ukukala leyo nhlanganisela, ilunga lokuqala lifinyelela umkhawulo walo ngezikhathi {f} zomthwalo.
frame.break.reserve-unbounded: Ukukala leyo nhlanganisela, akukho okufinyelela umkhawulo (ukusesha kumi ngezikhathi {f} zomthwalo).
frame.break.not-checked: Izixhumanisi {n} azinakho ukumelana kwezikulufo futhi azihlolwa.
frame.break.limits: Ixhume lihlolwa ngokuhlinza nangomthwalo wokuqonda kuphela, kusukela ezimpenjini zelungu, ngokuchasene namandla okuhlinza ezikulufweni (AISC 360-16 J3.6, φ = 0.75). Ukucindezela, ukuhlinza kwebhlokhi, izinsimbi zokushisela kanye nokuphula akuhlolwa. Ukukhululeka kuwukuxazulula kokuqala okuphindwe kabili, akukona ukuhlaziywa kwesibili.
frame.live.on: Okuphilayo: xazulula futhi emva kokuhlela ngakunye
frame.rc.aid: Ukuhlolwa kwekhonkrithi kwamabhimu nezinsika ngokwe-ACI 318-19, ngezisekelo ozisethele ngezansi. Imiphumela ikhona ukuze umhlolisisi ayihlole: ilusizo kuze kubhekwe yiye umuntu. Imikhosi yokuqala, kodwa insika engagxili yenziwa ngomthwalo wayo okhuliswe (6.6.4.5); ukukhuliswa kokugxila (6.6.4.6) akwakhiwe; akukho ukuklama kokujikeleza, akukho ukuklama kwezokuzamazama (isahluko 18), akukho ukuklama kwezibopho (25.7.2), azikho izindonga njengamapuleti okwamanje.
frame.rc.no-sections: Azikho amabhimu, izinsika noma izibopho okwamanje.
frame.rc.assume-note: Isigaba yidrowing onayo (b ngokuya kwe-y yesakhiwo, h ngokuya kwe-z yaso); ukuhlaziywa kusebenzisa iphrofayili edwetshiwe, futhi umehluko oshaya ngaphezu kuka-5 % ebungeni uyabhalwa. Izinduku ziyizinhlamvu emagumbini okumbozwa anikeziwe; ikhonkrithi yesisindo esijwayelekile; izinhlanganisela ziyezika ze-ASCE 7 (ACI 318-19 5.3.1).
frame.rc.err.no-forms: Setha okungenani isigaba esisodwa kuqala (“Setha njengekhonkrithi…”).
frame.rc.err.no-solution: Ukuhlaziywa akukanaxazululo: lungisa okubikwa yikho, bese uhlola futhi.
frame.rc.err.no-combos: Azikho izinhlanganisela zamandla okuhlolelwa kuzo. Cindezela “Yenza izinhlanganisela” kuqala.
frame.rc.why.area-mismatch: indawo edwetshiwe ihlukile ku-b × h ngaphezu kuka-5 %
frame.rc.why.axes-mismatch: amahlelo esigaba edwetshiwe awahambisani ne-b ngokuya kwe-y yesakhiwo kanye ne-h ngokuya kwe-z yaso
frame.rc.why.slender-sway: ukukhuliswa kokunyakaza (6.6.4.6) akukakhiwa: kudinga ukuhlaziywa kwesibili.
frame.rc.check.rc-slender-buckling: Ikholomu ende: umthwalo oqondile ngokuchasene ne-0.75 Pc (6.6.4.5.2)
frame.rc.title: Ukuhlola kwekhonkrithi
frame.rc.assume-text: Imikhosi yokuqala evela ekuhlaziyweni nge-{stiff}; K = {k}, {sway}; ikhonkrithi yesisindo esijwayelekile (E = 4700 √f’c, ν = 0.2); izinduku njengamaphoyinti; izinhlanganisela ze-ASCE 7. Yokuhlolwa umhlolisisi.
frame.rc.stiff-cracked: Izigaba eziqhekeziwe (insika 0.70 Ig, amabhimu 0.35 Ig, ACI 6.6.3.1.1)
frame.note.concrete: Izakhi zekhonkrithi: E = 4700 √f’c, G = E / 2.4, 2400 kg/m³.
frame.note.concrete-cracked: Izakhi zekhonkrithi: {n} zisebenzisa ukuqina kokugoba okuqhekeziwe (insika 0.70 Ig, amabhimu 0.35 Ig; ACI 318-19 Table 6.6.3.1.1(a)).
frame.note.concrete-gross: Izakhi zekhonkrithi: {n} zisebenzisa izigaba zazo eziphelele.
frame.rc.not-built-text: Ukukhuliswa kokugxila (6.6.4.6), ukuklama kokujikeleza, ukuklama kwezokuzamazama (isahluko 18), ukuklama kwezibopho (25.7.2), ukubamba nobude bokuxhumana, ukuhlehla, izindonga.
frame.eq.aid: Amandla angohlangothi alingene (12.8) emaphansini angaphansi njengamacala emithwalo, nokudonsa kwesitezi. Imiphumela ikhona ukuze umhlolisisi ayihlole: ilusizo kuze kubhekwe yiye umuntu. Ngayinye iphansi iba yidayaphrama eqinile ekuhlaziyweni.
frame.eq.none-found: Akutholakalanga zinga elinamabhimu noma izibopho ezimbili noma ngaphezulu. Engeza amaphansi ngesandla.
frame.eq.no-floors: Awukakabi namaphansi. “Thola amaphansi” ithatha amazinga lapho amabhimu ahlangana; bhala isisindo sephansi ngalinye (ingxenye yalo yomthwalo ongaguquki nanoma yisiphi esinye isisindo sokuzamazama).
frame.eq.floors-note: Bhala isisindo sephansi ngalinye, noma ulifunde emacaleni aphezulu: umthwalo oqondile wenodi ngayinye uya ephansini eliphezulu kwayo noma elifanayo, ngakho insika phakathi kwamaphansi amabili inikeza uhhafu wesisindo sayo kwelingayo. Engeza izigaba, 25 % somthwalo wokuphila wokugcina kanye nekhephu lophahla oluthe tshe (ASCE 7-22 12.7.2) ngesici kulawo macala.
frame.eq.weights-none: Nika okungenani icala elilodwa isici esingaphezu kuzero (okuthi ngu-1 kuze kushintshwe).
frame.eq.weights-err: Izisindo azikwazanga ukubalwa: ukuhlaziywa akukamodeli esebenzayo.

frame.eq.err.no-base: Uhlaka alunasekelo, ngakho alukho isisekelo samandla okuzamazama.

frame.eq.period-err.no-cases: Qala wenze amakeyisi okuzamazama bese uqalisa ukuhlaziya: isikhathi siza ekunyakazeni kwamafulathi ngaphansi kwawo.
frame.eq.period-err.no-motion: Amafulowa awazange anyakaze ngaphansi kwezimo zokuzamazama, ngakho akukho sikhathi esingafundwa.

frame.pl.title: Islebhu nezindonga (amapuleti)
frame.pl.method-text: Ama-shell aqinile ane-node ezine (ipuleti le-Mindlin nokusika kwe-MITC4, kanye nomshini), imizuzu nokusika ngemitha yobubanzi ngayinye ezinaksini zepuleti ngalinye (Mx igoba ngokuya kwe-x yepuleti, > 0 = ubuso be-−z ekuqineni). Imiphumela ikhona ukuze umhlolisisi ayihlole.
frame.pl.limits-text: Imizuzu yokwesekwa ihlangana kancane ngamapuleti ane-node ezine: hlukanisa imeshi eduze kwezisekelo. Imizuzu ephakathi nendawo nokudonsa kuseduze ngamapuleti ayi-16 ngakunye. Amapuleti ahlolwa ngemikhosi kuphela, hhayi ngensimbi yokuqinisa.

ml.sys.more.title: Uhlelo lokuqondanisa lalo mdwebo
ml.sys.more.intro: Sesha ngenombolo ye-EPSG, ngesifunda se-UTM (UTM 33N) noma ngamagama asegameni, layisha ifayela .prj, noma khetha kumaProjekshini ami. Umdwebo ugcina inombolo ye-EPSG, ngakho inchazelo kumele ifane nohlelo oluhlwini.
ml.sys.more.help: Bhala isifunda se-UTM noma inombolo ye-EPSG, noma thatha uhlelo kumaProjekshini ami. Likhethwa lapha bese lisetshenziswa ngo-Sebenzisa lolu hlelo, bese ligcinwa ku-DWG noma DXF.

ui.cmd.size.title: Hudula ukuze ubonise imigqa eminingi noma encane yomlando (chofoza kabili: umugqa owodwa noma emuva)
ui.cmd.grip.title: Hudula ukuze uphakamise umugqa womyalo phezu komdwebo; wehlise ebhareni lesimo ukuze uwubeke phansi. Izinkinobho zomcibisholo ziwuhambisa.
status.cmdline.float: Umugqa womyalo uphakame phezu komdwebo. Hudula isibambo sawo ukuze uwuhambise, noma uwulahle ebhareni lesimo ukuze uwubeke phansi.
status.cmdline.one: Umugqa womyalo owodwa. I-F2 ibonisa umlando.
set.cmdline.hint: Ukuphakama kubeka umugqa womyalo phezu komdwebo: hudula isibambo sawo ukuze uwuhambise, uwulahle ebhareni lesimo ukuze uwubeke phansi, bese uhudula insonga yawo yesokudla ukuze ushintshe ububanzi. Umphetho wawo ophezulu usetha ubude. 0 imigqa ichaza umugqa womyalo owodwa: imilayezo emisha ibonakala isikhashana futhi i-F2 (noma inkinobho yewashi) ivula umlando wonke. Ikhunjulwa kulesi siphequluli; Setha kabusha isakhiwo sikubeka phansi futhi.
set.top_area.hint: Okuncane kugcina amabha angaphezulu komdwebo emancane: akukho magama eqembu nezinkulumo ngaphansi kwezithonjana (amathuluzi amatsha nabafundi besikrini bawanazo), nezinkinobho ezincane kakhulu, kuzo zonke izitayela zemenyu. Izilungiselelo zeMigqa yethuluzi zisetha imigqa engakanani zisebenzisa.
cmd.commandline.help: Beka phansi noma uphakamise umugqa womyalo, wenze ube mugqa owodwa, usethe imigqa yomlando noma uvule umlando (F2)
cmd.commandline.lines.bad: Bhala inombolo ephelele ukusuka ku-0 kuya ku-12.
cmd.toparea.help: Yenza amabha angaphezulu komdwebo ajwayelekile noma ancane

credits.none.placed: Lo mdwebo awunazinto zoMtapo manje, ngakho setafula lishiywe njengalo. Lisuse uma lingasadingeki.
credits.help: Ibeka izikweletu zoMtapo emdwebeni njengetafula. Liqalise futhi ukuze uvuselele setafula ngezinto ezisemdwebeni manje.
plan2d.wall.now: Ubukhulu bodonga {t}. Imiphetho ethinta enye udonga iyahlanganiswa nalo.
plan2d.wall.justify: Ukuchofoza kuhamba phakathi, ngakwesobunxele noma ngakwesokunene kodonga
plan2d.wall.fill: Gcwalisa: Lutho, Okuqinile noma Imigqa yokufiphaza
plan2d.wall.help: Dweba udonga we-2D njenge-polyline. Ziyahlanganiswa, futhi zinamaminyango namawindi.
plan2d.door.place: Chofoza odongeni, ohlangothini umnyango ovulela kulo ({st}, {w})
plan2d.door.help: Faka umnyango odongeni. Uhlangothi ochofoza kulo yilo umnyango ovulela kulo.
plan2d.op.nowalls: Akukho madonga okufaka kuwo. Qala udwebe owodwa nge-WALL kuqala.
plan2d.op.long: Lo udonga mfushane kakhulu ngalobu bubanzi.
plan2d.op.overlap: Lokhu kuhlanganisa nomunye umnyango noma iwindi odongeni.
plan2d.del.pick: Chofoza udonga oseduze nomnyango noma iwindi ofuna ukulisusa
plan2d.hatch.broke: Imigqa yokufiphaza ayisaxhunyiwe: umkhawulo wayo ushintshile ngakho ayikwazi ukulandela. Imigqa yokufiphaza ayishintshile.
plan2d.hatch.assoc.on: Imigqa yokufiphaza emisha ilandela umkhawulo wayo.
plan2d.he.ask: Shintsha Ipheethini, Isikali, Ikona, Umsuka, Xhuma, Khumula (Enter lapho useqedile)
plan2d.he.objects: Khetha izinto ezivaliwe ezimkhawulela lo mgqa wokufiphaza
plan2d.he.help: Shintsha umgqa wokufiphaza: ipheethini, isikali, ikona, umsuka, nokuxhumeka kwawo komkhawulo.
plan2d.floors.help: Vula iphaneli lamaphansi: beka amaphansi ngaphezulu komunye esikhaleni esisodwa semodeli.
plan2d.floor.ask: Iphansi lokudweba kulo, noma Okusha, Hambisa, Kopisha, ? (manje {cur})
plan2d.floor.name: Igama lephansi
plan2d.floor.help: Khetha iphansi lokudweba kulo, engeza elilodwa, noma hambisa noma kopisha ukukhethwa kulo.
plan2d.floorlayers.done: Izinto {n} zihanjiselwe kongqimba abaqanjwe ngamaphansi azo. Amaphansi avaliwe kulo mdwebo; Hlehlisa uwabuyisele.
plan2d.floorlayers.help: Guqula amaphansi abe ngongqimba abanegama elithi Floor-Layer, kufayela elithunyelwa komuntu ongenawo amaphansi.
plan2d.floors.title: Amaphansi
plan2d.floors.intro: Beka amaphansi esikhaleni esisodwa semodeli: dweba iphansi lokuqala phezu kwephansi elingaphansi ngamakhodinethi afanayo, bese uvala ngalinye. Ongqimba basebenza kuwo wonke amaphansi. Lokho osudwebile kuze kube manje kuhlala ephansini elingaphansi.
plan2d.floors.name: Igama lephansi
plan2d.floors.delete.text: Susa {name}? Izinto zayo {n} ziyohamba ziye ephansini lokuqala elisele.
plan2d.floors.note: Iphansi olidweba kulo libonakala njengokujwayelekile. Amanye amaphansi avuliwe abonakala efiphele: ungawaxhuma kuwo kodwa awawashintshi. Esihlanganisweni, khetha iviewport bese ukhetha iphansi layo ku-Properties.
plan2d.floors.out.note: Ezinye izinhlelo ze-CAD azazi amaphansi futhi zibonisa wonke ndawonye. Lokhu kuhambisa ngalinye into ku-ungqimba obizwa ngokuthi Floor-Layer ukuze usakwazi ukuvala ngalinye iphansi. Hlehlisa uyibuyisele.
plan2d.group.ask: Okusha, Engeza ungqimba, Susa ungqimba, Susa, Isiqalo, Ngokwejwayelekile, ?
plan2d.group.name: Igama leqembu
plan2d.group.bad: Akukho leqembu elinjalo, noma igama selithathiwe.
plan2d.group.help: Hlanganisa ongqimba bibe amafolda kuPhaneli Yongqimba.
m3d.tool.click_to_select_drag_left_to: Chofoza ukuze ukhethe. Hudula kusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla ukuze ukhethe ngewindi, kusuka kwesokudla kuya kwesobunxele ukuze ukhethe ngokuqhathanisa. Chofoza kabili iqembu ukuze uvule.
m3d.tool.click_the_end_of_the_line: Chofoza ukuphela komugqa, noma bhala ubude. Esc iyima.
m3d.tool.click_the_opposite_corner_or_ty: Chofoza ikhona elingaphambili, noma bhala ububanzi, ukuphakama (isb. 4m,3m).
m3d.tool.click_the_first_corner_on_the: Chofoza ikhona lokuqala — phansi noma kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_red: Irektangeli ikhiyiwe kule pulani ebomvu (ime ngqo, ilingane nebomvu). Cindezela okhiye ofanayo ukuze uyikhiphe.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_green: Irektangeli ikhiyiwe kule pulani eluhlaza (ime ngqo, ilingane neluhlaza). Cindezela okhiye ofanayo ukuze uyikhiphe.
m3d.tool.rect_plane_blue: Irektangeli ikhiyiwe kule pulani eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (ilingile). Cindezela okhiye ofanayo ukuze uyikhiphe.
m3d.tool.click_to_set_the_radius_or: Chofoza ukusetha umsantsa, noma uwubhale. Bhala 12s ukuze uthole izinhlangothi ezingu-12.
m3d.tool.click_the_start_of_the_arc: Chofoza isiqalo somnsalo — phansi noma kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.click_the_end_of_the_arc: Chofoza ukuphela komnsalo, noma bhala ubude besitshalo sawo.
m3d.tool.move_to_bulge_the_arc_click: Hambisa ukuze wenze umnsalo ugobe, chofoza, noma bhala ukugoba. Bhala 12s ukuze uthole izingxenye ezingu-12.
m3d.tool.click_the_center_of_the_arc: Chofoza isikhungo somnsalo — phansi noma kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_arc_starts_or: Chofoza lapho umnsalo uqala, noma bhala umsantsa.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_arc_ends_or: Chofoza lapho umnsalo uphela, noma bhala i-engeli ngamadigri.
m3d.tool.click_where_this_point_goes_or: Chofoza lapho leli phoyinti liya khona, noma bhala <dx,dy,dz>. Esc iyibuyisela.
m3d.tool.click_a_square_to_move_that: Chofoza isikwele ukuze uhambise leli phoyinti lejika. Esc iphetha.
m3d.tool.click_the_next_point_enter_or: Chofoza iphoyinti elilandelayo. Faka noma chofoza kabili ukuqeda; chofoza iphoyinti lokuqala ukuze uyivale; Backspace ibuyisela emuva iphoyinti lokugcina.
m3d.tool.click_the_face_to_sweep_along: Chofoza uhlangothi okuzoshayelwa phezu kwalo ngomzila okhethiwe.
m3d.tool.click_the_face_to_sweep_then: Chofoza uhlangothi okuzoshayelwa, bese umphetho womzila — noma khetha umzila kuqala.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_to_offset_its: Chofoza uhlangothi ukuze ushintshele imiphetho yalo, noma khetha imiphetho kuqala. Chofoza kabili uhlangothi ukuze uphinde ibanga lokugcina.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_group_or_component: Chofoza uhlangothi, iqembu noma ingxenye ukuze uyipende. Ctrl: izinhlangothi ezixhunyiwe zalowo mbala · Shift: zonke izinhlangothi zalowo mbala · Alt: thatha umbala.
m3d.tool.move_to_push_or_pull_click: Hambisa ukuze uphushe noma udonse, chofoza ukuqeda, noma bhala ibanga.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_to_push_or: Chofoza uhlangothi ukuze uluphushe noma uludonse. Chofoza kabili uhlangothi ukuze uphinde ibanga lokugcina.
m3d.tool.click_a_point_to_move_from: Chofoza iphoyinti lokuqala lokuhambisa (khetha kuqala, noma into ephansi kwesikhombisi izohamba). Ctrl ikopisha.
m3d.tool.copied_type_3x_for_more_copies: Kukopishiwe. Bhala 3x ukuze uthole izikhopi eziningi ngokulandelana, noma /3 ukuhlukanisa ibanga.
m3d.tool.click_the_centre_of_rotation_on: Chofoza isikhungo sokuzungeza (phezu kohlangothi ukuze uzungeze endizeni yalo; izinkinobho zesikhombisi zikhetha i-akisi).
m3d.tool.click_a_point_to_start_the: Chofoza iphoyinti lapho kuqala khona i-engeli.
m3d.tool.click_to_set_the_angle_or: Chofoza ukusetha i-engeli, noma bhala amadigri.
m3d.tool.rotate_copy_on: Kukopishwa: okokuqala kuyahlala. Ctrl izungeza kunalokho.
m3d.tool.rotated_copy_type_3x: Kukopishiwe. Bhala 3x ukuze uthole izikhopi eziningi zizungeze isikhungo, noma /3 ukuhlukanisa i-engeli.
m3d.tool.move_to_turn_click_to_finish: Hambisa ukuze uphendule, chofoza ukuqeda, noma bhala amadigri. X, Y noma Z zikhetha i-akisi.
m3d.tool.move_to_resize_click_to_finish: Hambisa ukuze ushintshe usayizi, chofoza ukuqeda; noma bhala isilinganiso (2), noma esisodwa ngasinye ene-akisi (2,1,0.5 bomvu, oluhlaza, okwesibhakabhaka).
m3d.tool.drag_or_click_a_grip_on: Hudula noma chofoza isibambi ebhokisini: ikhona likhula ngokulinganayo, umphetho noma uhlangothi kuyelula (Ctrl: ngokuzungeze isikhungo). Noma chofoza iphoyinti elihlala lisendaweni.
m3d.tool.move_away_from_the_centre_to: Hambisa ukuze uye ngaphandle kwesikhungo ukuze ukhule, uye kuso ukuze wehle; chofoza ukuqeda, noma bhala isilinganiso.
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_a_group_a: Chofoza umphetho, iqembu, isiqondiso noma isilinganiso ukuze useze, noma hudula phezu kwezinhlobo eziningi. Izinhlangothi ziyahamba nemiphetho yazo.
m3d.tool.move_off_the_edge_and_click: Hamba ngaphandle komphetho bese uchofoza ukubeka umugqa wesiqondisi ofanayo, noma bhala ukushintshwa.
m3d.tool.click_to_measure_and_drop_a: Chofoza ukulinganisa nokubeka iphoyinti lesiqondisi, noma bhala ibanga.
m3d.tool.click_an_edge_to_start_a: Chofoza umphetho ukuze uqale umugqa wesiqondisi ofana nawo, noma iphoyinti lokulinganisa kuso.
m3d.tool.click_the_center_of_the_protrac: Chofoza isikhungo se-protractor — uma kuhlangothi, ilele kuleyo hlangothi.
m3d.tool.click_a_point_for_0_arrow: Chofoza iphoyinti lika-0° (okhiye bemicibisholo: beka i-protractor ilingane nebomvu, oluhlaza noma okwesibhakabhaka).
m3d.tool.move_to_the_angle_15_steps: Hambisa uye ku-engeli (izinyathelo ze-15° ziyabambeka) bese uchofoza, noma bhala i-engeli ngamadigri.
m3d.tool.move_to_place_the_dimension_lin: Hambisa ukuze ubeke umugqa wesilinganiso bese uchofoza, noma bhala ukushintshwa kwawo.
m3d.tool.drag_to_orbit_middle_drag_orbit: Hudula ukuze uzungeze; bamba Shift ukuze ushelelise. Ukuhudula kwephakathi kuzungeza nganoma yiliphi ithuluzi.
m3d.tool.drag_to_pan_shift_middle_drag: Hudula ukuze ushelelise. Shift + ukuhudula kwephakathi kushelelisa nganoma yiliphi ithuluzi.
m3d.tool.drag_up_and_down_to_zoom: Hudula phezulu nasezansi ukuze usondeze. Ivili lesikrolo lisondeza nganoma yiliphi ithuluzi.
m3d.tool.click_where_the_component_goes_: Chofoza lapho ingxenye iya khona (imvelaphi yayo ifika lapho).
m3d.tool.click_where_the_pasted_copy_goe: Chofoza lapho ikhophi enamathisiwe iya khona (ikhona layo elisezansi lifika lapho). Esc iyakhansela.
m3d.tool.this_curve_can_no_longer_be: Leli jika alisaguquleki (lelithe lelulwa noma lahlukaniswa); liphinde lidwebe.
m3d.tool.click_two_points_or_more_for: Chofoza amaphoyinti amabili noma ngaphezulu ukuze uthole ijika.
m3d.tool.that_edge_is_part_of_the: Lo mphetho uyingxenye yohlangothi: chofoza umphetho womzila.
m3d.tool.click_a_face_inside_the_open_2: Chofoza uhlangothi (ngaphakathi kweqembu elivuliwe), noma khetha imiphetho kuqala.
m3d.tool.push_pull_works_on_a_face: Ukuphusha/ukudonsa kusebenza phezu kohlangothi. Chofoza uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_move_first_: Khetha okuthile ukuze uhambise kuqala, noma chofoza kukho.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_rotate_firs: Khetha okuthile ukuze uzungeze kuqala, noma chofoza kukho.
m3d.tool.select_something_to_scale_first: Khetha okuthile ukuze ulinganise usayizi kuqala, noma chofoza kukho.
m3d.tool.type_a_factor_above_0_2: Bhala isilinganiso esiphezu kwe-0 (2), noma esintathu: bomvu, oluhlaza, okwesibhakabhaka (2,1,0.5).
m3d.tool.type_a_factor_above_0_such: Bhala isilinganiso esiphezu kwe-0, njengo-2 noma 0.5.
m3d.tool.move_off_the_edge_first_to: Hamba ngaphandle komphetho kuqala ukuze ukhombise uhlangothi.
m3d.tool.move_the_pointer_first_to_show: Hambisa isibonisi kuqala ukuze ukhombise uhlangothi lapho isilinganiso siya khona.
m3d.tool.circle_center: Chofoza isikhungo — phansi noma kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi. Bhala {eg}s ukushintsha izinhlangothi (manje: {n}).
m3d.tool.curve_done: Ijika elidlula kumaphoyinti: {n}. Khetha bese uchofoza Hlela amaphoyinti ku-Ulwazi lwento ukuze uyishintshe.
m3d.tool.curve_done_closed: Ijika elivaliwe elidlula kumaphoyinti: {n}. Khetha bese uchofoza Hlela amaphoyinti ku-Ulwazi lwento ukuze uyishintshe.

m3d.tool.follow_ring.one: Kushayelwe phezu komphetho: {n}. Izinhlangothi ezintsha: {faces}, indandatho evaliwe.
m3d.tool.follow_ring.other: Kushayelwe phezu kwemiphetho: {n}. Izinhlangothi ezintsha: {faces}, indandatho evaliwe.

m3d.tool.stopped_at: Kumile lapho ithinta khona, ibanga: {d}. Vala Ukuhlangana (phansi kwesokudla) ukuze udlule.
m3d.tool.move_where: Chofoza lapho iya khona, noma bhala ibanga. Ctrl yenza ikhophi.
m3d.tool.move_where_copy: Chofoza lapho iya khona, noma bhala ibanga. Ctrl ihambisa kunalokho.
m3d.tool.stopped_after: Kumile lapho ithinta khona, emva kwebanga: {d}. Vala Ukuhlangana (phansi kwesokudla) ukuze udlule.
m3d.tool.dim_start: Chofoza ikhona lokulinganisa kuso, noma umphetho (emsalweni noma endilingeni: umsantsa wayo noma ububanzi obuphindwe kabili).
m3d.tool.dim_start_resize: Chofoza ikhona noma umphetho ukuze ulinganise, noma bhala ubude ukuze ulungise okulinganiswe ngokuqondile.
m3d.model.a_face_would_shrink_to_nothing: uhlangothi lungancipha lube lutho noma luphenduke ngaphakathi
m3d.model.a_face_would_bend_out_of: uhlangothi lungagoba luphume endizeni yalo; linganisa ngomphetho, noma ngebomvu, oluhlaza noma okwesibhakabhaka
m3d.model.this_curve_bounds_a_face_that: Leli jika libopha uhlangothi oluphuma endizeni yalo (lusundulwe noma ludonswe): umsantsa wawo awukwazi ukushintsha manje.
m3d.model.a_curve_needs_two_points_or: Ijika lidinga amaphoyinti amabili noma ngaphezulu.
m3d.model.this_curve_can_no_longer_be: Leli jika alisaguquleki (lelithe lelulwa noma lahlukaniswa); liphinde lidwebe.
m3d.model.this_curve_bounds_a_face_erase: Leli jika libopha uhlangothi: susa kuqala uhlangothi, noma dweba ijika elisha.
m3d.model.choose_a_path_one_or_more: Khetha umzila: umphetho owodwa noma ngaphezulu oxhunyiwe.
m3d.model.the_path_branches_select_one_c: Umzila uyahlukana: khetha ishini elilodwa lemiphetho, ngaphandle kwezahlukaniso.
m3d.model.the_path_is_in_more_than: Umzila usesiqeshini ngaphezu kwesisodwa: khetha ishini elilodwa elixhunyiwe lemiphetho.
m3d.model.the_face_lies_along_the_path: Uhlangothi lulele umzila: luphendule ukuze udlule umzila (Landela mina iyashayela ngokuma phezu kwawo).
m3d.model.bad_image: Leso sithombe ayikwazi ukugcinwa: kuphela izithombe ze-PNG, JPEG nezi-WebP ezingaphansi kuka-18 MB.
m3d.model.bad_light: Lokho kukhanya akukwazi ukugcinwa: kudinga uhlobo nendawo.
m3d.tool.light_where: Chofoza lapho {kind} iya khona: ezingqeni noma odongeni ihlala ngaphandle kohlangothi kancane.
m3d.model.that_is_further_than_this_face: Lokho kudlula lolu hlangothi: uhlangothi luzophenduka ngaphakathi.
Lokho kudlula lolu hlangothi: isakhiwo esisha sizophambanisa sona.
m3d.model.offset_works_on_one_chain_of: Ukushintshela kusebenza ishini elilodwa lemiphetho: lezi zihlukana.
m3d.model.offset_works_on_one_connected_: Ukushintshela kusebenza ishini elilodwa elixhunyiwe lemiphetho.
m3d.model.that_is_further_than_these_edg: Lokho kudlula lemiphetho: ingxenye izophenduka ngaphakathi.
m3d.model.the_end_that_moves_is_not: iphetho elinyakazayo alilona ikhona lemodeli; khetha ukuthi yiliphi iphetho elihambayo ku-Ulwazi lwento
m3d.tool.divide_pick: Chofoza umphetho noma ijika ukuze uluhlukanise (noma khetha lolo kuqala), noma bhala inani lezingxenye.
m3d.tool.divide_move: {n} izingxenye: hambisa uye ngasemaphethelweni ukuze uthole ezinengi, uye ngasemaphakathini ukuze uthole ezimbalwa; chofoza ukuhlukanisa, noma bhala inani.
m3d.mesh.name: Imeshi
m3d.mesh.pick_a_group: Khetha iqembu noma ingxenye ukuze uyiguqule ibe imeshi.
m3d.mesh.busy: Imeshi iyahlelwa; zama futhi ukuhlela kuphele.
m3d.io.this_obj_file_could_not_be: Leli fayela le-OBJ alikwazanga ukufundwa njengombhalo.
m3d.io.this_obj_file_has_more_than: Leli fayela le-OBJ linamaphoyinti angaphezu kwezigidi ezi-2: likhulu kakhulu ukuze limodeliswe lapha.
m3d.io.this_obj_file_has_more_than_2: Leli fayela le-OBJ linezinhlangothi ezingaphezu kwezigidi ezi-2: likhulu kakhulu ukuze limodeliswe lapha.
m3d.io.this_gltf_file_is_too_big: Le fayela le-glTF likhulu kakhulu ukuze limodeliwe lapha (ngaphezu kwamavertex ayi-2 wezigidi).
m3d.io.a_buffer_view_runs_past_its: ukubuka kwebhafa kuchitheka ngaphezu kwebhafa lakho
m3d.io.an_accessor_runs_past_its_buffer: i-accessor ichitheka ngaphezu kokubuka kwebhafa layo
m3d.io.this_dxf_file_could_not_be: Le fayela le-DXF alikwazanga ukufundwa njengombhalo.
m3d.io.this_is_a_binary_dxf_save: Le yi-DXF enebhayina. Yilondoloze njenge-DXF ye-ASCII bese uzama futhi.
m3d.io.this_drawing_reaches_more_than_10: Lo mdwebo ufinyelela ngaphezu kuka-10,000 km kusukela kumsuka wawo: uwusondeze ku-0,0 kuhlelo lwe-CAD bese uzama futhi.
m3d.io.this_drawing_has_more_than_2: Lo mdwebo unemigqa engaphezu kwezigidi ezi-2: mkhulu kakhulu ukuze uletwe lapha.
m3d.io.this_drawing_has_more_than_200: Lo mdwebo unamahetshi nobuso be-3D okungaphezu kuka-200,000: mkhulu kakhulu ukuze uletwe lapha.
m3d.io.this_model_is_too_big_to: Le modeli inkulu kakhulu ukuze ihlelwe njenge-DXF noma i-DWG (ngaphezu kwezinto ezi-2 wezigidi).
m3d.io.this_collada_file_is_too_big: Le fayela le-Collada likhulu kakhulu ukuze limodeliwe lapha (ngaphezu kwamavertex ayi-2 wezigidi).
m3d.io.a_vertex_is_not_a_number: i-vertex akuyona inombolo noma ingaphezu kuka-10,000 km ngaphandle
m3d.io.this_collada_file_has_more_than: Le fayela le-Collada linobuso obungaphezu kwezigidi ezi-2: likhulu kakhulu ukuze limodeliwe lapha.
m3d.io.nodes_nested_too_deep_or_inside: ama-node afakwe ijulile kakhulu noma angaphakathi kawo ngokwawo
m3d.io.this_collada_file_has_no_geometry: Le fayela le-Collada alinayo i-geometry ModelCraft engayingenisa.
m3d.dwg.this_is_not_a_dwg_drawing: Lo akusona umdwebo we-DWG (izinhlamvu zawo zokuqala akusona uphawu lweweyishini ye-DWG).
m3d.model.file_newer: Le modeli ilondolozwe yi-ModelCraft entsha (uweyishini wefayela {v}). Buyekeza i-ModelCraft ukuze uyivule.
m3d.io.obj_vertex: Leli fayela le-OBJ linevertex engayona inombolo (umugqa "{line}").
m3d.io.gltf_external: Le fayela le-glTF ligcina idatha yalo kwelinye ifayela ("{uri}"). Yithumele njenge-.glb eyodwa bese uyivula.

frame.so.on: Umyalo wesibili (P-Delta): imikhosi eqondile isebenza ohlakeni olugobile
frame.so.result: Umyalo wesibili: ukudlula {n}, ukunyakaza {a} × ukunyakaza komyalo wokuqala (izingcezu {seg} ngelilungu ngalinye).
frame.so.not-converged: Umyalo wesibili: imikhosi eqondile ayizinzanga ngemva kokudlula: {n}. Phatha lezi zimiphumela njengezingathembeki.
frame.so.note: Ukuhlaziywa kokuqina komyalo wesibili (P-Delta yohlaka, kanye ne-P-delta yelilungu ngalinye elinqunywe libe izingcezu {seg}): inhlanganisela ngayinye ixazululwa ngemikhosi yayo eqondile, ingafakwa ndawonye. Okuqinile, izinguquko ezincane, akukho ukuncishiswa kokuqina noma imithwalo yokuqagela (akulona ngokwayo indlela ye-AISC direct analysis).
frame.err.second-order-unstable: Umyalo wesibili: uhlaka luyagoba ngaphansi kwalezi zimithwalo (ku: {at}, {dof}): imikhosi eqondile ingaphezu komthwalo obalulekile wokuqina. Nciphisa imithwalo noma uqinise uhlaka.
frame.warn.second-order-plates: Umyalo wesibili awenziwa kumaslebhu, izindonga namaphansi aqinile: lokhu kuhlaziywa kungowokuqala.
frame.fem.slab-mitc4: I-shell yamanodi amane, ukhulu noma uncane (MITC4)
frame.fem.about: Ixazulula lo modeli ngenjini yamaelementi aphelele: amabhimu njengakhona (ukukhululwa kwamaphethelo kuyagcinwa), amaslebhu nezindonga njengama-shell amanodi amane, amaphansi aqinile, izisekelo. Ubuningi wukuminyana kwempahla ephindwe ngevolumu; imithwalo ayengezi ubuningi. Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.fem.err.no-mass: Akukho okunobuningi, ngakho akukho okungadlidlizela. Nika impahla ukuminyana, bese uphinda uqalise.
frame.fem.err.no-dofs: Akukho okukhululekile ukunyakaza: wonke amahlanganiso abanjiwe.
frame.fem.warn.not-converged: Amafrikhwensi awazinzanga ezindleleni ezivunyelwe. Phatha aphezulu njengezingathembeki.
frame.fem.mass: Ubuningi bamaelementi {kg} kg; ukungaziwa {dofs}. Izabelo ziwubuningi obusebenzayo bendlela ngayinye ngakwi-eksisi yomhlaba ngayinye, njengengxenye yobuningi obungahamba (ubuningi bamahlanganiso abanjiwe bushiywe ngaphandle).
frame.fem.title: Amafrikhwensi emvelo
frame.fem.method: Amaelementi aphelele: amalungu anokuqina kwawo nobuningi obufanayo, amaslebhu nezindonga njengama-shell amanodi amane athe xaxa, amaphansi aqinile ngaphakathi endizeni yawo; i-subspace iteration yezindlela eziphansi kakhulu.
frame.fem.limits: Okuqinile, izinyakazo ezincane. Imithwalo yamalungu nemithwalo esetshenziswayo ayiguqulwa ibe ubuningi. Akukho ukudlidliza, akukho isipeksitramu sokusabela. Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.

frame.floor.about: Isebenza kuwo wonke amaslebhu ekhonkithi ahlaziywe, njengengcindezi phezu kwendawo yawo (imithwalo esindayo nehlala yefulowa). Amaslebhu nezindonga zisekuhlaziyweni kwezakhiwo zekhonkithi kuphela.
frame.floor.no-slabs: Lo modeli awunaslebhu lekhonkithi ekuhlaziyweni, ngakho ingcindezi ayinamthelela.
frame.ld.not-check: Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.ld.w.aid: Umoya esakhiweni esivalekile, esiqinile ngendlela yesistimu eyinhloko emelana nomoya (ASCE 7 isahluko 27, izakhiwo zazo zonke izimo): ingcindezi yejubane ngalinye leflowa, ingcindezi yodonga oluhlangene nomoya nolungaphambili, nomkhosi kuleflowa ngalinye, njengamacala emithwalo phezu kwamaphansi aqinile. Usizo kuze kubuyekezwe unjiniyela.
frame.ld.w.need-speed: Thayipha isivinini somoya esisisekelo V esivela kumephu yakho yomoya (amazinga Wezigaba Zengozi awafakiwe lapha) ukuze ubone imithwalo yomoya.
frame.ld.w.need-run: Qalisa ukuhlaziya (Run) ukuze amaflowa nosayizi wesakhiwo kwaziwe, bese imithwalo yomoya ibonakala lapha.
frame.ld.w.geometry: Ipulani {X} m ngokuya kwe-X, {Y} m ngokuya kwe-Y; ukuphakama kophahla lwesilinganiso {h} m ngaphezu kwezisekelo.
frame.ld.w.summary: Umoya ngokuya {dir}: qh = {qh} kPa, L/B = {LB}, umkhosi esakhiweni {total} kN.
frame.ld.w.warn-leeward-cp: L/B: {LB}. I-Cp ngasemuva ebhalwe njengo −0.5 isebenza kuze kube ngu-1 ye-L/B. Amanani esakhiwo eside awaqinisekiswanga emithonjeni emibili yomphakathi, ngakho kusetshenziswa −0.5 (ohlangothini oluphephile); thayipha i-Cp kusuka ekopini yakho yesitendi ebhokisini ukuze uyishintshe.
frame.ld.w.warn-minimum: Umthwalo osincane wodonga wama-16 psf uphatha kumaflowa anophawu *.
frame.ld.w.warn-gust-changed: G akuyona 0.85: kwakhiwa isakhiwo esiqinile kuphela (amafrikhwensi emvelo ang-1 Hz noma ngaphezulu); isakhiwo esithambile sidinga inani lokuqhuma kusuka kumutho.
frame.ld.w.warn-roof-below-top: Ukuphakama kophahla oluwunikile kungaphansi kweflowa eliphezulu.
frame.ld.w.note: Indlela eqondile ye-ASCE 7-10 / 7-16, isakhiwo esiqinile (G 0.85), izindonga Cp 0.8 ngaphambili kanye no −0.5 ngasemuva; ingcindezi yangaphakathi iyaqothuka ngakho sonke isakhiwo. Umthwalo wefulowa ngalinye iyingcindezi phakathi kwesigamu sesitezi ngaphezulu nangaphansi, kuwo wonke ububanzi besakhiwo. Ingcindezi yophahla, amacala okujikeleza, izakhiwo ezithambile, i-ASCE 7-22 nengcindezi yokumboza akwakhiwe. Ingxenye yesitendi ngayinye yenombolo ayiphuma kuyo, namakhasi awaprinta, ahlelwe ku-"Imithombo". Isivinini somoya V siwuJubane elisisekelo lendawo yakho: thayipha lona.
frame.ld.w.made: Yenziwe amacala omoya {n} (isamba esikhulu somkhosi {F} kN). Yengeza kuzinhlanganisela ngo-"Yenza izinhlanganisela ze-ASCE 7".
frame.ld.s.aid: Ss no-S1 (kumamephu ekhodi, noma ukubheka kwe-USGS ngezansi), uhlobo lwendawo nesistimu yesakhiwo kunikeza SDS, SD1, R, Cd no-Ω0 nesipeksitramu sokusabela somklamo; "Sebenzisa ebhulokhini lokunyakaza komhlaba" igcwalisa ibhulokhi lemithwalo yokunyakaza komhlaba ngaphezulu ngazo. Usizo kuze kubuyekezwe unjiniyela.
frame.ld.s.d-exception: Uhlobo lwendawo D ne-S1 esingu-0.2 noma ngaphezulu: khulisa i-SM1 ngo-50 % kukho konke ukusetshenziswa (ukuzikhethela kwe-ASCE 7-16 11.4.8) esikhundleni socwaningo oluthile lwendawo
frame.ld.s.usgs-note: Ukubheka kwenziwa ku-inthanethi kuphela uma ucindezela inkinobho: kuthumela lo bubanzi, lobude, izinga lengozi nohlobo lwendawo kwi-U.S. Geological Survey design-maps web service (earthquake.usgs.gov/ws/building-codes). Ukuthayipha Ss no-S1 kusebenza njalo ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.

frame.ld.c.note: Izinhlanganisela zamandla (LRFD, 2.3) noma zokucindezeleka okuvunyelwe (ASD, 2.4) zamacala e-Dead, Live, ophahla, isinowa, umoya nokunyakaza komhlaba, nomthelela wokunyakaza komhlaba oqondile 0.2 SDS D nomfanekiso ρ wokweqisa; nezinhlanganisela ze-overstrength (Ω0) futhi. Ezi-LRFD zimakwe ukuhlola kwamalungu; ezi-ASD nezi-overstrength ziyaxazululwa kodwa azihlolwa njengoklamo. Izinhlanganisela iphrojekthi ezidingayo zezikanjiniyela zakho ukuzimisela.
frame.ld.c.no-sds: SDS ingu-0: umthelela wokunyakaza komhlaba oqondile awufakiwe.
frame.ld.src.h: Imithombo yomoya, yokunyakaza komhlaba nezinhlanganisela, nokuthi yini eshiywe ngaphandle
frame.ld.src.about: Yonke inombolo inikezwa okungenani amakhasi omphakathi amabili azimele (efundwe {date}); isitendi ngokwaso aseqoqiwe. Lapho amakhasi ayengavumelani noma kutholwa eyodwa kuphela, inani lishiywe ngaphandle futhi lidwetshwe ngezansi.
frame.ld.err.no-speed: Thayipha kuqala isivinini somoya esisisekelo V.
frame.ld.err.no-floors: Akukho maflowa okwamanje: cindezela Thola amaflowa (noma uwengeze ebhulokhini lokunyakaza komhlaba), bese uqalisa.
frame.dyn.mass-about: Ubuningi wukuminyana kwempahla kanye nevolumu, kanye nemithwalo ehla yamacala angezansi, ngayinye iphindwe ngesilinganiso sayo (isibonelo icala lokufa ku-1 nalo icala lokuphila ngesabelo osithatha njengobuningi). Isisindo secala ngalinye asibalwa kabili. Izilinganiso ezithayiphiwe ziyizinqumo zakho; akukho okungumthetho wekhodi lapha.
frame.dyn.rs.about: Ukuhlaziywa kwesipeksitramu sokusabela sendlela kumodeli yamaelementi aphelele: izindlela ezitholiwe, ngayinye ifundwa esipeksitramini ngesikhathi sayo, ihlanganiswe nge-CQC noma nge-SRSS, bese izinqondo ziyahlanganiswa ndawonye. Inikeza ukunyakaza okuhlanganisiwe ngezindlela, ukuphambuka kwezitezi, imikhosi yamalungu nokusika kwesisekelo. Okuqinile. Isipeksitramu ngesakho: ithebhu, noma umumo we-ASCE 7 osuselwa ku-SDS, SD1 no-TL. Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.rs.signs: Amanani ahlanganisiwe awanaphawu: ayisilinganiso esikhulu esingenzeka sesenzo ngasinye, hhayi icala lomthwalo. Imikhosi yamalungu ingamandla ekugcineni; ukusika nokugoba akuhlanganiswa ngesiqu selungu.
frame.dyn.rs.method: Isipeksitramu sendlela ehlanganisiwe: {m}, ukuhlanganiswa kwezinqondo {rule}, ukucindezeleka {xi} % kuzo zonke izindlela (isipeksitramu sithathwa njengoba sinikeziwe ngalokho kucindezeleka).
frame.dyn.rs.limits: Okuqinile. Akukho ukulungiswa kwembobo engekho. Ukuphambuka kwezitezi kuqinile futhi akuphindwe ngesilinganiso sokukhuphuka, futhi akuhlolwa nganoma yimuphi umkhawulo. Izindlela ezinezikhathi ezisondelene ziphathwa nge-CQC, noma ngomthetho wamaphesenti angu-10 uma ukhethwe. Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.sp-asce7: Umumo we-ASCE 7 kusuka ku-SDS, SD1, TL
frame.dyn.sp-use: Sebenzisa amanani ebhulokhini lokunyakaza komhlaba (SDS {SDS}, SD1 {SD1})
frame.dyn.sp-rows: Isikhathi (s) nokusheshisa kwesipeksitramu, ipheya eyodwa ngomugqa ngamunye
frame.dyn.m-tenpct: Umthetho wamaphesenti angu-10 (SRSS, ngezindlela ezisondelene ezengeziwe)
frame.dyn.th.about: Umlando wesikhathi oqondile ngaphansi kokusheshisa komhlaba: ukwengezwa kwezindlela (indlela ngayinye ixazululwa ngokunembile irekhodi elingumugqa oqhubekayo) noma ukuhlanganiswa okuqondile (Newmark average acceleration, Rayleigh damping). Imiphumela iyizikhathi ezilandelanayo nemvilophu yalokhu kuqukethwe ngakunye. Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.th.signs: Imvilophu yemikhosi yamalungu iyinani elikhulu kakhulu lesenzo ngasinye sokuphela phezu kwerekhodi lonke, noma liphi icala.
frame.dyn.th.method: {m}; izinyathelo {n} ngesinyathelo {h} s; Newmark average acceleration noma izinyathelo ezinembile zezindlela ezingumugqa oqhubekayo; iqala kokuphumula.
frame.dyn.th.limits: Okulinganayo nokuqinile. Iqala ekuphumuleni ngaphandle kwesimo sokudonsela. Irekhodi lisetshenziswa njengoba linikezwe: akukho ukuhlunga, ukulungisa isisekelo noma ukulinganisa kwesipeksitramu. Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.syn-note: Okokufaka okwenziwe: kwenziwe ukuhlola imodeli, hhayi irekhodi lokunyakaza komhlaba langempela.
frame.dyn.rec-paste: Noma unamathisele: isikhathi nokusheshisa ngomugqa ngamunye, noma ukusheshisa okukodwa ngomugqa ngamunye nesinyathelo esingenhla
frame.dyn.rec-lost: Lide kakhulu ukuligcina kanye nemodeli: vula ifayela futhi.
frame.dyn.rec.session: lide kakhulu ukuligcina kanye nemodeli: ligcinwe kulesi seshini kuphela
frame.dyn.rec.err.columns: Umugqa ngamunye udinga inombolo eyodwa (ukusheshisa) noma ezimbili (isikhathi, ukusheshisa).
frame.dyn.rec.err.time-order: Izikhathi kumele zikhule kusuka komunye umugqa kuya komunye.
frame.dyn.rec.err.need-dt: Irekhodi lekholomu eyodwa lidinga isinyathelo sesikhathi esingenhla.
frame.dyn.direct-note: Ukuhlanganiswa okuqondile kusebenzisa ukudlidliza kwe-Rayleigh: isilinganiso sifakwa ezindleleni zokuqala nezisezingeni eliphezulu ezisetshenzisiwe. Ukudlidliza kwezindlela ngezilinganiso ezihlukile kuya kokwengezwa kwezindlela.
frame.dyn.ps.about: Okungemileyo okungashukumi: ophahla luyasunduzwa ngasohlangothini ngezinyathelo ezincane; amagxolo wezinhlobo zepulasitiki akha ezigxotsheni zamalungu (okuqinile, okuphuthuma noma nokuqina okwengeziwe, umkhosi wokuqondana unciphisa umzuzwana wepulasitiki). Ingaba-ne-P-delta uma ukhethiwe. Umphumela: ijika lokukwazi (ukusika kwesisekelo ngokuya ekunyakazeni kophahla) nezimo zamagxolo. Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.ps.stopped.no-convergence: Ukusebenza kumile lapha: izibalo zimile ukuzinza, ngokuvamile ngesakhiwo esiwile noma ngokungazinzi.
frame.dyn.ps.stopped.strength-lost: Ukusebenza kumile lapha: ukusika kwesisekelo kwehle kwaphansi kwengxenye yesihlanu yenani lalo elikhulu kakhulu.
frame.dyn.ps.method: Amagxolo wepulasitiki amaphethelweni amalungu, ukuqina kwesivuno {fy} MPa, ukuqina {r} % wokuqina kwephethelo, P-delta {pd}; ukulawula ukusunduza kophahla; izinqubo eziphelele zepulasitiki zivela esakhiweni se-I esidweshiwe (ama-fillet akulanga).
frame.dyn.ps.limits: Amagxolo amaphethelo wamalungu kuphela (beka inodi lapho kumele kwakheke khona ngaphakathi kwesikhala). Amalungu angelona isakhiwo se-I ahlala ekuhlehleni. Ukuvuma kwe-axial nokugoba kwama-brace akulingiswa. Izilaba nezindonga zihlala zihlehla. Azikho imibandela yokwamukelwa enikeziwe. Akulona ukuhlola kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.fy-note: Iphuzu lensimbi lesakhiwo sokuklama linamandla {fy} MPa; ulibhale phezulu ukuze lisetshenziswe.
frame.dyn.cap-chart: Ivini lamandla: ukucindezela kwesisekelo ngokumelene nokunyakaza kophahla
frame.dyn.nl.about: Imigoqo efanayo ngaphansi kokunyakaza komhlaba nokucindezeleka kwe-Ibhulokhi ye-Time history (i-Rayleigh ezindlelweni ezinikezwe lapho), i-Newmark average acceleration nokuphindaphinda kwe-Newton, kusukela esimeni sokudonsela phansi esingenhla. Kuhamba kancane kumamodeli amakhulu: yigcine kwamancane lapha.
frame.dyn.err.no-mass: Akukho okunobunzima. Nikeza impahla yokwakha ukuminyana, noma thatha isimo somthwalo njengobunzima phezulu.
frame.dyn.err.no-dofs: Akukho okukhululekile ukuhamba: wonke amanodi abanjiwe.
frame.dyn.err.no-modes: Azikho izimo zokunyakaza ezingatholakala kule modeli.
frame.dyn.err.no-direction: Zonke izinqondo zivaliwe: nikeza okungenani okukodwa isikali esingaphezu kuka-0.
frame.dyn.err.no-record: Akukho kunyakaza komhlaba okuzosebenza. Khetha okokufaka okwenziwe noma layisha irekhodi.
frame.dyn.err.too-many-steps: Izinyathelo zesikhathi ngu-{n}: ngaphezu kuka-200,000 (40,000 kokusebenza okungelona olulinganayo). Sebenzisa isinyathelo sesikhathi esikhulu.
frame.dyn.err.bad-damping: Isilinganiso sokucindezeleka kwesimo esithile singaphandle kuka-0 kuya kuka-100 %. Hlola izimo ze-Rayleigh.
frame.dyn.err.too-big-direct: Ukuhlanganisa okuqondile kukhawulelwe kumamodeli afika ku-6,000 okungaziwa kanye nenani elincane lezinyathelo; sebenzisa ukuhlanganisa kwezimo, noma yenze kwi-workstation.
frame.dyn.err.no-hinges: Akukho sakhi esingakha i-hinge: nikeza izakhi isimo se-I (izigaba zensimbi ku-Ibhulokhi Yokuklama).
frame.dyn.err.no-floors: Azikho iphansi ezitholakele: ukusunduza kudinga izinga elinamaxhumanisi amabili, noma iphansi eliqinile.
frame.dyn.err.no-control: Iphansi eliphezulu alinaxhumanisi angasunduzwa ngale eksisi yodwa.
frame.dyn.err.rec-need-dt: Irekhodi lekholomu eyodwa lidinga isinyathelo sesikhathi.
frame.dyn.warn.mass-short: Ku-{dirs} izimo ezisetshenzisiwe zithwala {pct} % kuphela wobunzima: sebenzisa izimo eziningi (90 % yinjongo ejwayelekile). Obunye bobunzima abukho emphumeleni.
frame.dyn.warn.zero-sa: Isipekhthiramu singu-0 esikhathini sesimo esisodwa noma ngaphezulu.
frame.dyn.warn.step-coarse: Isinyathelo sesikhathi sikhulu kunesarekhodi: izinga eliphakeme phakathi kwezampula liyaphuthelwa.
frame.dyn.warn.direct-rayleigh: Ukuhlanganisa okuqondile kusebenzise ukucindezeleka kwe-Rayleigh okulingana nezimo zokuqala nezokugcina ezisetshenzisiwe.
frame.dyn.warn.braces: {n} isakhi/izakhi akhululiwe emaphethelweni womabili noma azikwazi ukwakha i-hinge: ukuthamba nokugoba kwalezi zakhi akulingiswa.
frame.dyn.warn.gravity-yield: Ama-hinge sekwathamba ngaphansi komthwalo wokudonsela phansi ngaphambi kokuqala ukusunduza.
cmd.style.help: Izitayela zombhalo: ifonti, ukuphakama, ububanzi nokuthambekela okuthatwa umbhalo omusha (ingxoxo; -STYLE kumugqa womyalo)

tstyle.err.exists: Isitayela sombhalo nalelo gama sesivele sikhona.
