plan2d.wall.offset: Ukuthuthela kokubekwa: udonga luya kangakanani kwesobunxele kokuchofoza (okungaphansi: kwesokudla)
plan2d.wall.join.on: Izindonga ozidweba manje zizoxhumana nezindonga ezifinyelela kuzo.
plan2d.wall.join.off: Izindonga ozidweba manje ngeke zixhumane: zizogcina iziphetho ezisikwele.
plan2d.tool.rect.help: Dweba izindonga ezine ezixhunyiwe kusukela emakhoneni amabili aphambene, njenge-RECTANG.
plan2d.tool.rot.third: Iphoyinti ecaleni lapho ezinye izindonga zihamba khona (ukuthi kukhulu kangakanani kusetha ububanzi)
plan2d.tool.rot.help: Dweba izindonga ezine ezixhunyiwe njengesikwele esijikiwe kunoma iyiphi ingeli: icala lokuqala, bese ukuthi kukhulu kangakanani.
plan2d.tool.poly.help: Dweba izindonga ezizungeze i-polygon elinganayo enezinhlangothi ezi-3 kuya kwezingu-64, njenge-POLYGON.
plan2d.tool.arc.help: Dweba umnsalo wezindonga. Izindonga zeplani zimqondo, ngakho umnsalo udwetshwa njengezindonga ezimfushane ezimqondo (ama-degree angu-15 ngalinye) ezixhumayo.
plan2d.tool.tan.pick: Chofoza udonga ukuze uqhubeke, eduze nesiphetho salo
plan2d.tool.tan.help: Qhubeka nodonga ngomnsalo ohamba ngokusuka kudonga (udwetshwa njengezindonga ezimfushane ezimqondo).
plan2d.tool.pick.pick: Chofoza umugqa noma iphola-layini ukuze wenze izindonga kuwo
plan2d.tool.pick.help: Yenza izindonga emugqeni noma ephola-layini kumdwebo, nemigqa exhunyiwe kuyo uma uthi Yebo.
plan2d.tool.trace.point: Chofoza ngaphakathi kwendawo evaliwe ukuze uyilandele
plan2d.tool.trace.help: Yenza izindonga ezizungeze indawo evaliwe encane kakhulu yemigqa nezindonga ezungeze iphoyinti olichofozile.
plan2d.tool.split.point: Lapho kuhlukaniswa (I-Gap ne-Free ends zisetha indlela; iziphetho ezikhululekile ziba {free})
plan2d.tool.split.door: Ukusika kungadlula emnyango noma kwiwindi. Khetha indawo engenalutho kuyo.
plan2d.tool.split.help: Hlukanisa udonga ibe ngamabili endaweni enikeziwe noma lapho enye udonga ludlula khona. Izingxenye zihlala zixhunyiwe uma ungacelanga igebe noma iziphetho ezikhululekile. Iminyango nawindi zihamba nengxenye yazo.
plan2d.tool.delseg.pick: Chofoza udonga ukuze usike isicucu kuwo
plan2d.tool.delseg.help: Sula isicucu sodonga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili. Okushiyeke kuhlala njengezindonga ezimbili noma eyodwa.
plan2d.tool.rejoin.no: Lezo zimbili azenzi udonga olulodwa: kufanele zibe mugqa munye, zibe ubukhulu obufanayo futhi zingabi ngaphezu kwe-5 m ukuhlukana.
plan2d.tool.rejoin.help: Yenza izingxenye ezimbili zodonga zibe udonga olulodwa futhi. Okokuqala kugcina indawo yakhe emdwebeni.
plan2d.tool.dim.notdim: Lokho akuyona isilinganiso somugqa noma esihleliwe.
plan2d.tool.dim.walls: Amaphethelo amabili alowo msilinganiso kufanele ngamunye abe kudonga oluhlukile.
plan2d.tool.dim.along: Lowo donga uhamba ngokuhambisana nesilinganiso, ngakho ukuwuhambisa ngokusikwele ngeke kushintshe inani.
plan2d.tool.dim.help: Bhala inani elisha lesilinganiso: udonga oluseceleni lwalo olukude luhamba ngokusikwele kuwona wodwa, udonga oluseceleni lokuqala luyama, nezindonga ezixhunyiwe kuwo zilandele.
plan2d.tool.offset.help: Hambisa udonga ngokusikwele kuwona wodwa ngebanga elithile (izindonga ezixhunyiwe kuwo ziyalandela), noma yenza ikhophi ebangeni elo.
plan2d.tool.stretch.first: Ikhona lokuqala lewindi elizungeze iziphetho zodonga ozoziweba
plan2d.tool.stretch.none: Akukho siphetho sodonga esingaphakathi kulowo windi.
plan2d.tool.stretch.help: Weba ngewindi: iziphetho zezindonga ezingaphakathi kuwo ziyanyakaza, izindonga ezingaphakathi ngokuphelele ziyanyakaza zonke, nezindonga ezigxila ezinhlangothini zazo ziyahamba nazo.
plan2d.tool.joins.help: Nikeza wonke udonga lomdwebo omdala inombolo yalo bese ugcina okuxhumana phakathi kwawo. Lokhu futhi kwenzeka ekushintsheni kokuqala okwenzayo.
plan2d.tool.hold.noid: Lowo donga alinayo inombolo okwamanje. Qala nge-WALLJOINS.
plan2d.tool.hold.subject: Chofoza udonga ozokhiya
plan2d.tool.hold.mode: Lingana kuqala, noma Gcina ibanga elikhona manje
plan2d.tool.hold.parallel: Lezo zindonga azihambisani, ngakho ibanga phakathi kwazo alikwazi ukukhiywa.
plan2d.tool.hold.done: Ukhiyiwe. Ukuhambisa elinye lezindonga kuhambisa elinye ukuze kugcinwe; ukuhambisa zombili ngokwehlukile kuyenqatshelwa.
plan2d.tool.hold.help: Lingana futhi ukhiye: udonga luhlala endaweni yalo ngokumelene nodonga oluthile (emgqeni walo, noma ngebanga alinalo). Uma elinye lihamba, elinye liyalandela.
plan2d.tool.holddim.done: Ibanga phakathi kwezindonga ezimbili likhiyiwe ku-{v}.
plan2d.tool.holddim.help: Khiya ibanga phakathi kwezindonga ezimbili ezihambisanayo. Uma elinye lihamba, elinye liyalandela ukuze kugcinwe.
plan2d.tool.grid.wall: Chofoza udonga ukuze ukhiye emgqeni wegridi
plan2d.tool.grid.notgrid: Lokho akuyona umugqa wegridi (umugqa osendaweni yegridi).
plan2d.tool.grid.notag: Lowo mugqa wegridi awunalebula. Beka ilebula yawo ombhalweni osesiphethweni esisodwa.
plan2d.tool.grid.mode: Khiya udonga Ngokuhambisana nomugqa, noma nge-End kuwo
plan2d.tool.grid.notalong: Lowo donga awuhambi ngokuhambisana nomugqa wegridi.
plan2d.tool.grid.done: Ukhiywe emgqeni wegridi {tag}. Lapho umugqa uhamba, udonga luyalandela.
plan2d.tool.grid.help: Khiya udonga emgqeni wegridi: ngokuhambisana nawo, noma isiphetho sodwa kuwo. Hambisa umugqa nge-GRIDMOVE udonga luyalandela.
plan2d.tool.unhold.pick: Chofoza udonga ukuze ususe izikhiyo zalo
plan2d.tool.unhold.help: Susa izikhiyo kudonga (nezikhiyo zezinye izindonga kulo).
plan2d.tool.holds.line: Udonga {id}: lukhiywe kwelinye udonga, lukude ngu-{off}
plan2d.tool.holds.dim: Udonga {id}: ibanga kwelinye udonga likhiywe ku-{v}
walls.err.open: Akukho ndawo evaliwe ezungeze lelo phoyinti.
walls.err.tangent: Isiphetho sisemgqeni udonga oluhamba kuwo: lokho kuyudonga oluqondile, hhayi umnsalo.
walls.err.cutgap: Lelo gebe lishiya udonga omncane kakhulu.
walls.err.held: Ukhiyo luzophulwa: ushintsho alwenziwanga. Susa ukhiyo kuqala (WALLUNHOLD), noma hambisa odongeni olulodwa kuphela kwezimbili.
walls.err.heldturn: Ukhiyo luzophulwa ngokuphendula udonga: ushintsho alwenziwanga.
walls.err.gridturn: Umugqa wegridi uphendukile, ngakho udonga okhiyiwe ngeke usaye ngokusikwele kuwo: ushintsho alwenziwanga.
model.err.short: Lokho kuzoshiya udonga omfushane kakhulu noma kuwuphendule ubuyele kuwona wodwa. Ushintsho alwenziwanga.

cmd.arc.nothing_to_continue: Akukho okuzoqhubeka kuso: qala ngokudweba umugqa noma ijika kuqala.

cmd.arc.err.same: Lawo maphoyinti amabili afanayo: akukho jika.
cmd.arc.err.line: Amaphoyinti amathathu ahlelwe emugqeni owodwa: akukho jika.
cmd.arc.err.direction: Iphoyinti lokuphela lisendleleni yalesi siqondo: lokho kungumugqa, hhayi ijika.
cmd.arc.err.radius: Irediyasi imfishane kakhulu ukufinyelela iphoyinti lokuphela.
